阿尔达汉位于库拉河上游的高原平地，四周群山环绕。格鲁吉亚人称这一地区为阿尔塔阿尼；城堡守卫着阿哈尔齐赫与卡尔斯至埃尔祖鲁姆道路之间的交通要冲。城墙多次重建，反映出格鲁吉亚及邻近统治者对这片边疆的长期争夺。

十六世纪奥斯曼人征服以前，阿尔达汉属于格鲁吉亚的萨姆茨赫公国。1555年的《阿马西亚和约》确认了奥斯曼人对萨姆茨赫西部的占有，阿尔达汉成为桑贾克的中心。1828—1829年俄奥战争期间，此地的交通位置仍有价值；在边疆要塞之间行军的军队必须面对高原与严冬。

english: Ardakan lies northwest of Yazd on the edge of the central Iranian desert. Its old town was enclosed by high walls, within which stood mosques, houses and religious endowments supplied by the oasis. The town is mentioned in Ilkhanid sources and was home to the Sufi lodge of the Dada'i shaykhs. In the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries these teachers and their endowments formed part of Ardakan's religious life; the Zir Deh mosque also dates from the Safavid period.
simp_chinese: 阿尔达坎位于亚兹德西北、伊朗中部沙漠边缘。老城曾由高墙环绕，墙内有清真寺、房屋和依靠绿洲维持的宗教捐产。伊儿汗国文献已有此地记载，这里也是达达伊派谢赫苏菲修道院的所在地。十六至十七世纪，这些导师及其捐产构成阿尔达坎宗教生活的一部分；齐尔德清真寺同样建于萨法维时期。

english: Ardatov stands on the Lemeti, in the wooded country southwest of Nizhny Novgorod. It was recorded in 1578 as the palace village of Ordatova, administered by the Kazan Palace office. Catherine II made it a district town in 1779. Its market brought together local produce and goods brought from Arzamas and other towns, while the surrounding district included villages of Erzya Mordvin inhabitants as well as Russian settlements.
simp_chinese: 阿尔达托夫位于列梅季河畔，地处下诺夫哥罗德西南的林地。1578年的记载称它为宫廷所属的奥尔达托瓦村，由喀山宫廷衙门管辖。1779年，叶卡捷琳娜二世将它升为县城。当地市场汇集附近农产和从阿尔扎马斯等城市运来的货物；周边地区既有厄尔兹亚莫尔多瓦人的村落，也有俄罗斯人的聚居地。

english:
Ardestan lies between Kashan and Na'in, near the edge of the Dasht-e Kavir. In the Middle Ages its walls enclosed a prosperous town known for pomegranates, silk production and weaving. Water was precious in the surrounding villages, and irrigation sustained gardens in this dry country. A sixteenth-century traveller estimated the town at some five hundred houses.

The Friday mosque preserves traces of several periods. Its earlier arcaded sanctuary was extensively rebuilt under the Seljuks around 1158–1160, when the mosque acquired its domed chamber and four-iwan plan. Brickwork, inscriptions and elaborate stucco adorn the sanctuary. Around 1539–1540, under the Safavids, the mosque was enlarged again and received a madrasa, showing how the old religious centre continued to change.
simp_chinese:
阿尔德斯坦位于卡尚与纳因之间，靠近卡维尔盐漠的边缘。中世纪时，这座繁荣的城镇有城墙环绕，以石榴、丝绸生产和织工闻名。周围村庄缺水，在干旱地区维持园林需要灌溉。一位十六世纪旅行者估计镇上约有五百户人家。

聚礼清真寺保存着不同时期的建筑痕迹。原有的拱廊礼拜空间在塞尔柱时期约1158至1160年大规模改建，形成穹顶厅和四伊万布局。砖砌结构、铭文和精细的灰泥装饰点缀着礼拜空间。萨法维时期约1539至1540年，清真寺再次扩建，并增设宗教学校，显示这座古老宗教中心仍在持续变化。

english:
Ardra, or Allada, was a powerful Aja kingdom between the interior and the coast of the Bight of Benin. Its royal centre, known to Europeans as Great Ardra, stood inland; the kingdom also controlled coastal outlets through which merchants reached Atlantic ships. Royal traditions linked Allada to Tado on the Mono River and to neighbouring dynasties at Abomey and Hogbonu.

During the seventeenth century Allada became a major participant in the Atlantic trade in enslaved people. Its position was challenged as both Dahomey to the north and Hueda on the coast grew stronger. In 1724 King Agaja of Dahomey invaded and captured Allada. Many of its people were enslaved and sent to the coast, and refugees from the royal lineage later established a new centre at Hogbonu.
simp_chinese:
阿尔德拉又称阿拉达，是贝宁湾海岸与内陆之间一个强大的阿贾王国。欧洲人所称的“大阿尔德拉”王权中心位于内陆，王国还控制沿海出入口，商人由此接触大西洋船只。王室传统将阿拉达同莫诺河畔的塔多，以及邻近的阿波美、霍格博努王朝联系起来。

十七世纪，阿拉达成为大西洋奴隶贸易的重要参与者。随着北方的达荷美和沿海的休达日益强大，它的地位受到挑战。1724年，达荷美国王阿加贾入侵并攻占阿拉达，许多居民被奴役并送往海岸；王族中的逃亡者后来在霍格博努建立了新的中心。

english:
Ardtornish lies on the Sound of Mull at the mouth of the Rannoch River, where a sheltered anchorage faces the mountains of Morvern. Fertile coastal ground and sea routes made the site valuable to clans controlling western Scotland. Fishing, cattle and passing ships supplied the local economy.

The castle was a residence of the MacDonald Lords of the Isles. From the fourteenth century their sea-borne domain linked the Hebrides, western Highlands and Ireland. Ardtornish controlled movement through the Sound of Mull and served as a base for counsel, tribute and naval expeditions. In 1462 John of Islay negotiated the Treaty of Ardtornish with England against the Scottish crown.

Royal power broke the Lordship in the late fifteenth century. Ardtornish passed to Campbell owners and the medieval castle decayed, but the anchorage and route remained. Its history belongs to a maritime lordship where castles guarded straits rather than large inland estates. The sheltered bay also sustained fishing and passage along the western sea road.
simp_chinese:
阿德托尼斯位于马尔海峡、拉诺赫河口，避风锚地面对莫文山地。肥沃海岸与海路使这里对控制苏格兰西部的氏族具有价值，捕鱼、牛群和过往船只维持地方经济。

城堡曾是麦克唐纳群岛领主的驻地。十四世纪起，他们的海上领地连接赫布里底、西部高地和爱尔兰。阿德托尼斯控制马尔海峡交通，并作为会议、贡赋和海上远征基地。1462年，约翰·伊斯雷在此同英格兰议定《阿德托尼斯条约》，反对苏格兰王权。

十五世纪末王权击破群岛领主权，城堡后来转入坎贝尔家族并逐渐荒废，锚地和航路仍然重要。它的历史属于以城堡守卫海峡的海洋领主世界，而非大型内陆庄园。避风小湾还维持捕鱼和西部海路上的往来，使城堡即使荒废仍保留交通意义。

english:
Ardyaloon, also known as One Arm Point or Bardi, overlooks turbulent waters off Western Australia's Dampier Peninsula. The dry tropical coast is broken by mangroves, reefs and inlets, swept by powerful tides. Its sea country lies at the entrance to King Sound, where mainland camps faced the islands of the Buccaneer Archipelago.

For Bardi communities, land and sea formed one inherited estate. Family groups moved between coastal camps with the seasons and ritual calendar, while estate boundaries are traditionally said to extend into the water as far as a person could swim. Bardi voyagers used kalwa, rafts of mangrove wood pegged together in two overlapping sections. These craft carried them on fishing and hunting trips and short crossings to offshore islands in difficult tidal channels.

Passages and reefs around One Arm Point connected Bardi camps with offshore islands and neighbouring groups. Kalwa crossings depended on reading wind, tide and swell, and on timing journeys through King Sound's powerful currents. The point's rocky shelf and sheltered lee offered landing places for fishing and coastal travel.
simp_chinese:
阿迪亚隆又称独臂角或巴尔迪，面向西澳大利亚丹皮尔半岛北端湍急的海水。干燥的热带海岸分布着红树林、礁区和小型湾澳，并承受当地最强劲的潮汐。这里的海洋故土位于金湾入口，大陆营地与海盗群岛的岛屿隔水相望。

对巴尔迪社群而言，陆地与海洋构成同一份继承而来的家园。家族群体依照季节和仪式历在海岸营地之间迁居，传统上认为其产业边界一直延伸到人能够游到的海面。巴尔迪航海者使用卡勒瓦，即用木钉把两段红树木材叠接而成的双体筏。它载着人们捕鱼、狩猎，并在复杂潮道中短程往返近海岛屿。

独臂角周边的水道与礁区把巴尔迪营地、近海岛屿和邻族联系起来。卡勒瓦航行依靠辨认风向、潮汐与洋涌，并选择恰当时机穿过金湾的强劲海流。岬角的岩架与背风处提供捕鱼和沿岸航行的登陆点。

english: San José de Arechuna was a mission settlement on the Arauca River in the western Venezuelan Llanos. Founded in 1774 by Justo de Granada, it later became known as El Viento. The river runs through a plain of grasslands and wetlands where the rainy season brings extensive flooding. Like other eighteenth-century missions in Apure, Arechuna formed part of the expansion of colonial settlements into the Llanos.
simp_chinese: 圣何塞德阿雷丘纳是委内瑞拉西部亚诺斯阿劳卡河畔的传教聚落。胡斯托·德格拉纳达于1774年建立此地，后来称为埃尔维恩托。河流穿过草原与湿地，雨季会造成大片土地淹水。与阿普雷其他十八世纪传教聚落一样，阿雷丘纳属于殖民聚落向亚诺斯扩展的一部分。

english: Arecibo lies on Puerto Rico's northern Atlantic coast, near the mouth of the Río Grande de Arecibo. Its name recalls Arasibo, the Taíno chief of the settlement of Abacoa. Spanish colonists settled here in 1556, and the town was formally founded in 1616. In 1702 Captain Antonio de los Reyes Correa and local militia repelled a British landing, an episode remembered in the town's name for Captain Correa. Arecibo received the title of villa by royal decree in 1778. The port and river mouth connected the settlement with its hinterland and the sea, while the waters off the coast formed part of the wider Caribbean world.
simp_chinese: 阿雷西博位于波多黎各北部大西洋海岸，靠近阿雷西博大河河口。地名纪念阿瓦科阿聚落的泰诺首领阿拉西博。西班牙殖民者于1556年在此定居，城镇于1616年正式建立。1702年，安东尼奥·德洛斯雷耶斯·科雷亚上尉与地方民兵击退英国登陆部队，这段经历留在城镇纪念科雷亚的称号中。1778年，阿雷西博依据王室法令获得镇的称号。港口和河口将聚落与腹地及海洋联系起来，近岸水域也属于更广的加勒比海世界。

english: The Areia River runs through the upper Araguaia country, within the extensive homeland of the Bóe, or Bororo, people. Bororo accounts remember a village called Koitoguru near the meeting of the Areia and another river, and the river itself was known as a place rich in fish. Wooded valleys and the open cerrado meet in this part of central Brazil.
simp_chinese: 阿雷亚河流经上阿拉瓜亚地区，位于博埃人、即博罗罗人的广阔家园之内。博罗罗人的叙述记得一座名叫科伊托古鲁的村落，位于阿雷亚河与另一条河流汇合处；阿雷亚河则以鱼类丰富著称。林木覆盖的河谷与开阔的塞拉多在巴西中部这一带相接。

english:
Areia Reef lies in the coastal waters off the mouth of the São Francisco River, which reaches the Atlantic between the Alagoas and Sergipe coasts. The river connects the shore with a vast inland basin, and its lower course carried traffic between the sea and the interior.

Farther upriver, Penedo became a town in 1636. Dutch forces occupied it in 1637 and built Fort Maurício to secure access along the São Francisco. Fighting over the lower river shaped the struggle for northeastern Brazil, and the reef's waters belonged to that coast.
simp_chinese:
阿雷亚礁位于圣弗朗西斯科河口外的沿海水域，河流在阿拉戈斯与塞尔希培的海岸之间注入大西洋。河流把海岸与广阔的内陆流域连接起来，下游承担着海与内陆之间的运输。

在更上游的佩内杜，聚落于1636年升为城镇。荷兰军队于1637年占领此地，并修筑毛里西奥堡，以保障沿圣弗朗西斯科河进入内陆的通路。争夺下游河道的战事塑造了巴西东北部的争斗格局，这片礁石所在的海域也属于这一海岸。

english:
Arequipa stands in the valley of the Chili River beneath the volcanoes of the southern Peruvian Andes. Its streets and churches are built largely of pale volcanic stone called sillar, giving the city its distinctive appearance. The fertile valley had long been cultivated by Indigenous communities before the Spanish founded their town in 1540.

The colonial city grew around its main square as a center connecting the Pacific coast with the Andean interior. Religious houses occupied extensive compounds, while merchants and farmers supplied the growing population. The monastery of Santa Catalina was founded in 1579 with the support of María de Guzmán and the authorization of Viceroy Francisco de Toledo. Behind its walls, cloisters, cells and courtyards gradually formed a city within the city. Builders combined European forms with local materials and craftsmanship: massive walls, arches and vaulted roofs supported richly carved façades.

Earthquakes and the eruption of Huaynaputina in 1600 damaged the city, demanding repeated reconstruction. After the earthquake of 1582, builders increasingly used sillar, a relatively light and workable stone, for structures as well as doorways. Native masons contributed to the intricate decoration of the Baroque façades that followed. Arequipa remained an important city of southern Peru through the final years of Spanish rule and the emergence of the republic. Its stone architecture and irrigated surroundings bear witness to a history shaped by both the volcanic landscape and the people who made a home in its valley.
simp_chinese:
阿雷基帕坐落在秘鲁南部安第斯火山脚下的奇利河谷。街道和教堂大多以称作“锡利亚尔”的浅色火山石建造，赋予城市鲜明的面貌。西班牙人于1540年建城之前，原住民社区早已在肥沃谷地中精耕。

殖民城市围绕主广场发展，成为连接太平洋海岸与安第斯内陆的中心。宗教机构占据大片院落，商人和农民供养不断增长的人口。圣卡塔利娜修道院于1579年在玛丽亚·德古斯曼的资助下建立，并得到总督弗朗西斯科·德托莱多的许可。围墙之内，回廊、修女居室与庭院逐渐形成了一座城中之城。建造者将欧洲形式与当地材料、工艺相结合：厚墙、拱门和穹顶支撑着精雕立面的建筑。

地震以及1600年瓦伊纳普蒂纳火山爆发破坏了城市，居民屡次重建。1582年地震后，建造者越来越多地将轻巧而易于加工的锡利亚尔用于建筑结构，而不只是门框。原住民石匠也参与了随后兴起的巴洛克立面的精细装饰。西班牙统治末期和共和国形成期间，阿雷基帕仍是秘鲁南部的重要城市。石砌建筑与灌溉田地共同见证了火山地貌及在谷地安家的人们塑造的历史。

english: The Arerius, also recorded as Reriú and under several other spellings, were among the Indigenous peoples of colonial Ceará. Their country formed part of the northeastern interior where Portuguese expeditions, missions and cattle ranches expanded during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. The many names preserved in colonial records reflect the difficulties of identifying groups whose lands and relationships were altered by conquest.
simp_chinese: 阿雷里乌斯人也见于雷里乌等多种拼法，是殖民时期塞阿腊的原住民族之一。他们的生活地区属于巴西东北部内陆，葡萄牙远征队、传教站和牧场于十七至十八世纪向这里扩张。殖民文献保留的众多名称，也反映出征服改变了各群体的土地与联系，后人难以据此辨别其身份。

english: Ares del Maestre clings to a high rocky spur in the mountains of the Maestrat, beneath the remains of its castle. Its position made the town a commanding point among the roads and valleys of the interior. During the War of the Spanish Succession it suffered severe destruction in 1707, when troops of Philip V burned the town and its church. The church was later rebuilt with a Baroque façade, reflecting the recovery of the community after the war.
simp_chinese: 阿雷斯德尔马埃斯特依附在马埃斯特拉特山区高耸的岩石岬角上，城堡遗迹俯瞰镇子。这里居高临下，控制着内陆山谷与道路。西班牙王位继承战争期间，费利佩五世的军队于1707年焚毁城镇及教堂，造成严重破坏。教堂后来以巴洛克式立面重建，见证了战后社区的恢复。

english:
Aresh was a commercial town in the Shaki country of western Shirvan, on the road towards Barda. Its surrounding district produced abundant raw silk, attracting Turkish, Syrian and other merchants. The English traveler Anthony Jenkinson counted Aresh among the most prosperous trading cities he encountered in the sixteenth century. A castle guarded the town, and Safavid rulers briefly struck silver and copper coins in its name.

In 1548 the ruler of Shaki, Dervish Muhammad Khan, defeated a combined Safavid and Georgian force at Aresh, but the town became part of the Safavid state in 1551. Ottoman forces occupied it during the wars over Shirvan and built a wooden fortress; a Safavid prince recaptured and destroyed the town in 1578. Shah Abbas rebuilt its walls in 1606. When Evliya Çelebi visited in 1647, he described a large town with mosques and schools, reflecting its recovery from the earlier devastation.
simp_chinese:
阿雷什是希尔凡西部沙基地区的商业城镇，位于通往巴尔达的道路上。周围地区盛产生丝，吸引了土耳其、叙利亚及其他地方的商人。十六世纪英国旅行家安东尼·詹金森将阿雷什列为他所见最繁荣的贸易城市之一。城堡守卫着城镇，萨法维统治者还曾短暂铸造以阿雷什为名的银币和铜币。

1548年，沙基统治者达尔维什·穆罕默德汗在阿雷什击败萨法维与格鲁吉亚联军，但1551年城镇归入萨法维国家。奥斯曼军队在争夺希尔凡的战争中占据此地，修筑木堡；1578年，一位萨法维王子收复并摧毁了城镇。阿拔斯沙于1606年重建城墙。1647年埃夫利亚·切勒比到访时，描述了拥有清真寺和学校的大城，显示它已从早先的破坏中恢复。

english: Arévalo stands between the Adaja and Arevalillo rivers, its brick churches and castle reflecting the town's long royal connections. The council built a royal palace here under Henry II, and the future Isabella I spent much of her childhood in Arévalo with her mother, Isabella of Portugal. During the succession struggles of the fifteenth century the town became a prize of noble politics: in 1469 Henry IV granted it to Álvaro de Zúñiga, count of Plasencia, in return for his renewed allegiance.
simp_chinese: 阿雷瓦洛坐落在阿达哈河与阿雷瓦利略河之间，砖砌教堂和城堡反映出城镇与王室的长期联系。恩里克二世统治时，市议会在此建造王宫；未来的卡斯蒂利亚女王伊莎贝拉一世童年大部分时间在阿雷瓦洛与母亲葡萄牙的伊莎贝拉共同度过。十五世纪王位继承斗争中，此镇成为贵族政治的筹码：1469年，恩里克四世将它赐给普拉森西亚伯爵阿尔瓦罗·德苏尼加，以换取他的重新效忠。

english:
Arezzo is an Etruscan hill city in the upper Arno valley, one of the twelve cities of the Etruscan league, where the bronze Chimera was found in 1553. The commune threw off its bishop's control in 1098 and was an independent, generally Ghibelline city-state, with a university founded in 1252, until 1384. After the defeat at Campaldino in 1289 its fortunes ebbed, apart from a brief period under the Tarlati family and Bishop Guido Tarlati, who died in 1327.

His brother Pier Saccone, pressed by internal enemies, Florentines and Perugians and by economic crisis, handed Arezzo to Florence for ten years in 1337 for money; independence came back but not prosperity. In 1384 the city was annexed by Florence, and Florentine art took over: the last local painter, Spinello Aretino, gave way to Piero della Francesca, who painted the Legend of the True Cross in the basilica of San Francesco, while the Aretine historian Leonardo Bruni served as secretary of the Florentine Republic. The city rose against Florence with Vitellozzo Vitelli and Cesare Borgia, and again in 1529 after plague and famine, but the Medici army retook it after 1530. Under the grand duchy, the neighbouring marshes of the Val di Chiana were drained in the eighteenth century. In February 1796 an earthquake swarm of more than thirty tremors ended, tradition says, through the Madonna del Conforto, and in 1799 the Viva Maria revolt against the French rallied around her image.
simp_chinese:
阿雷佐是阿尔诺河上游山丘上的一座伊特鲁里亚城市，属于伊特鲁里亚联盟的十二城之一，1553年在此发现了青铜奇美拉像。1098年，市镇摆脱了主教的控制，此后直到1384年都是独立的城邦，大体倾向吉伯林派，1252年创办了大学。1289年坎帕尔迪诺战败后，它的势力衰退，只有塔拉蒂家族，尤其是1327年去世的主教圭多·塔拉蒂当权的短暂时期例外。

他的兄弟皮耶尔·萨科内受内部反对者、佛罗伦萨人和佩鲁贾人以及经济危机的压迫，1337年用阿雷佐换了一笔钱，把城市交给佛罗伦萨十年；独立回来了，繁荣却没有。1384年阿雷佐被佛罗伦萨吞并，佛罗伦萨艺术随之占上风：最后一位本地画家斯皮内洛·阿雷蒂诺之后是皮耶罗·德拉·弗朗切斯卡，他在圣方济各大殿画了《真十字架传说》，而阿雷佐籍历史学家莱昂纳尔多·布鲁尼则担任佛罗伦萨共和国的书记官。16世纪初，阿雷佐与维泰洛佐·维泰利和切萨雷·博尔贾一起反叛佛罗伦萨，1529年瘟疫和饥荒后再度起事，但1530年之后美第奇家族的军队重新夺回此城。18世纪，大公国治下，阿雷佐南面的基亚纳河谷沼泽被排干。1796年2月一连串共三十多次地震，据传统说法因慰藉圣母（Madonna del Conforto）而止息，1799年反法的“玛利亚万岁”起义便围绕她的圣像发动。

english: Arga-Tas is a mountain range in northeastern Siberia, extending roughly north-northwest to south-southeast for almost a hundred kilometres. It stands at the southern end of the Moma Range, west of the Kolyma valley, among the many ridges of the Chersky mountain system. High, cold and remote, these mountains divide the headwaters of rivers flowing through the Indigirka and Kolyma regions toward the Arctic.
simp_chinese: 阿尔加塔斯是西伯利亚东北部的一条山脉，大致从西北偏北向东南偏南延伸近一百公里。它位于莫马山脉南端、科雷马河谷以西，属于切尔斯基山系众多山脊之间的高地。这里高寒而偏远，群山分隔着因迪吉尔卡与科雷马地区流向北冰洋的河流源头。

english: The Argada descends from the Ikat Range to join the Barguzin in the broad valley east of Lake Baikal. Its waters flow through a basin enclosed by the Ikat and Barguzin mountains, where wooded slopes rise above the river flats. The Barguzin carries the combined waters southwest to Barguzin Bay on Baikal. The river valley forms a natural passage between the highlands and the great lake.
simp_chinese: 阿尔加达河从伊卡特山脉流下，在贝加尔湖以东的宽阔河谷汇入巴尔古津河。河水穿过伊卡特山脉与巴尔古津山脉围绕的盆地，森林山坡高出河流平地。巴尔古津河将汇合后的水流向西南送入贝加尔湖的巴尔古津湾。河谷形成高地与大湖之间的天然通道。

english: Argamakli Sarai was a Golden Horde town on the right bank of the Hromokliia, a tributary of the Inhul. Its name has been interpreted as a palace associated with fine horses; the river itself was once known as Argamakly. Foundations of stone buildings and a mosque mark the medieval site. An eighteenth-century description noted that its buildings had been dismantled, leaving stone foundations visible, while a 1772 map marked a Tatar mosque here.
simp_chinese: 阿尔加马克里宫是金帐汗国时期的一座城镇，位于因胡尔河支流赫罗莫克利亚河右岸。地名被解释为与骏马有关的宫殿；这条河本身曾称阿尔加马克勒。石建筑与清真寺的地基标志着中世纪城址。十八世纪的一份记述称建筑已被拆毁，只留下可见的石基；1772年的地图则在此标出一座鞑靼清真寺。

sources.title: Horpynych Vlasni nazvy i vidtoponimni utvorennia Inhulo Buzkoho mezhyrichchia.pdf

english: Argas lies on the right bank of the Lungkha, in the Central Yakutian Lowland. The river winds through a country of lakes and forest before joining the Lena, whose immense valley lies to the east. A severe continental climate rules this northern interior, with long winters and a short summer along the waterways.
simp_chinese: 阿尔加斯坐落在中雅库特低地的伦加河右岸。河流蜿蜒穿过湖泊和森林，最终注入东面拥有广阔河谷的勒拿河。严酷的大陆性气候支配着这片北方内陆，水道沿岸冬季漫长，夏季短促。

english: Argaxtaax lies on the left bank of the Alazeya, north of the Arctic Circle. The river winds through a lake-rich lowland on its way to the East Siberian Sea. In the 1640s Russian explorers established the Alazeya winter quarters as a centre for collecting fur tribute; Yukaghir and Even communities also lived in the wider river basin.
simp_chinese: 阿尔加赫塔赫坐落在北极圈以北的阿拉泽亚河左岸。河流蜿蜒穿过湖泊众多的低地，流向东西伯利亚海。十七世纪四十年代，俄国探险者建立阿拉泽亚冬营地，作为征收毛皮贡赋的中心；更广阔的河流流域中也生活着尤卡吉尔人和鄂温人社群。

english: Argenta lies on the low plain between Ferrara and Ravenna, near the wetlands of the Po delta. Founded in Roman times, it became a meeting place for the Ghibelline leaders of Romagna in 1295. There they gathered to decide their course in the struggle against papal forces. The town stood in a landscape shaped by rivers and marshes, close to the lagoon country around Comacchio.
simp_chinese: 阿真塔坐落在费拉拉与拉韦纳之间的低平原上，靠近波河三角洲的湿地。城镇建于罗马时代，1295年，罗马涅地区的吉伯林派首领在此集会，商议与教皇军队斗争的方略。河流与沼泽塑造了周围的景观，科马基奥一带的潟湖地带也近在咫尺。

english:
Argentan lies on the Orne in southern Normandy. Its castle, churches and lace-making tradition speak to the town's long history as both a place of lordship and a centre of skilled work. During the Hundred Years' War, its position exposed it repeatedly to fighting between the French and English crowns.

In 1356 English troops plundered Argentan and burned its castle. The viscounty passed to Pierre II, Count of Alençon, in 1372. Centuries later, Argentan shared in the French crown's efforts to establish a domestic luxury lace industry: a bureau for the production of point de France was set up here in 1665, as at nearby Alençon. Argentan needle lace went on to find wealthy and influential patrons at the French royal court itself.
simp_chinese:
阿让唐位于诺曼底南部的奥恩河畔。城堡、教堂和花边工艺，展示了这座城镇作为领主驻地及手工业中心的悠久历史。百年战争期间，它的位置使其屡次受到英法王室之间战事的波及。

1356年，英军劫掠阿让唐并焚毁城堡。1372年，阿朗松伯爵皮埃尔二世获得了阿让唐子爵领。几个世纪后，法国王室致力于建立本国的奢侈花边业，阿让唐也参与其中：1665年，这里和附近的阿朗松一样设立了生产法国针绣花边的机构。阿让唐针绣后来获得了法国王室宫廷中富有而显赫的顾客的青睐。

english:
Curtea de Argeș lies on the Argeș River beneath the Southern Carpathians. It was an early seat of the Wallachian princes, with a princely court and church at the centre of the emerging state. The Orthodox metropolitan also made his seat here, giving the town religious as well as political importance.

The court remained a leading residence during the fourteenth century, although the princes later favoured Târgoviște. In the early sixteenth century Neagoe Basarab commissioned a magnificent monastery church at Argeș. Consecrated in 1517, its richly carved stone and graceful towers expressed the prince's patronage and the artistic ties of Wallachia to the Byzantine world. The metropolitan seat moved to Târgoviște, but the monastery and princely church preserved the memory of the old capital and its rulers.
simp_chinese:
库尔泰亚德阿尔杰什位于南喀尔巴阡山麓的阿尔杰什河畔，是瓦拉几亚诸侯早期的驻地。新兴国家的中心设有王公宫廷和教堂，东正教都主教也在此设驻地，使城镇兼具宗教和政治意义。

十四世纪，宫廷仍是主要居所，但诸侯后来更常驻在特尔戈维什泰。十六世纪初，尼亚戈耶·巴萨拉布在阿尔杰什兴建宏伟的修院教堂。教堂于1517年祝圣，丰富的石雕和优美塔楼体现了大公的赞助，也反映瓦拉几亚与拜占庭世界的艺术联系。都主教驻地迁往特尔戈维什泰后，修院和王公教堂仍保存着旧都及其统治者的记忆。

english: Arghestan takes its name from a river of the dry uplands east of Kandahar. The Arghestan flows southwest through valleys and plains before joining the Tarnak, a tributary of the Arghandab. Together these rivers drain the southern Afghan mountains toward the Helmand basin. Along their courses, narrow strips of cultivable land interrupt the broad stretches of stony and arid ground.
simp_chinese: 阿尔格斯坦得名于坎大哈以东干旱高地上的河流。阿尔格斯坦河穿过山谷和平原向西南流，汇入阿尔甘达布河的支流塔尔纳克河。这些河流共同将阿富汗南部山地的水带向赫尔曼德盆地，沿河分布的狭长耕地打断了大片多石而干燥的荒原。

english: Lake Ogoron lies between the Soktakhan and Dzhagdy ranges on the upper Zeya plain. The Dep flows out of the lake and begins as a mountain river, before crossing lower, partly marshy ground toward the Zeya. Its tributaries include the Ninni and Bolshaya Kalakhta.
simp_chinese: 奥戈龙湖位于上结雅平原上，坐落在索克塔汉岭与贾格德岭之间。杰普河从湖中流出，上游是一条山地河流，下游穿过部分沼泽化的低地，流向结雅河。它的支流包括宁尼河与大卡拉赫塔河。

english: The Argolic Gulf cuts into the eastern Peloponnese, with Nafplio at its northwestern end and Spetses near its entrance. Mountains shelter its waters from the strong summer winds. In Nafplio's harbor, the Venetians fortified the islet of Bourtzi and linked it to the town with a chain to bar hostile ships. During the Greek War of Independence, insurgents captured the fort and used it to bombard the town and obstruct supplies to its Ottoman defenders.
simp_chinese: 阿尔戈利斯湾深入伯罗奔尼撒半岛东部，纳夫普利翁位于海湾西北端，斯佩察岛则靠近入口。周围山地为海湾挡住夏季的强风。在纳夫普利翁港内，威尼斯人在布尔齐小岛上修筑要塞，并以铁链将其与城镇相连，阻挡敌舰入港。希腊独立战争期间，起义者夺取堡垒，借此炮击城镇并阻截给奥斯曼守军的补给。

english:
Argos stands on the fertile plain of the Argolid, beneath the hill of Larissa and its ancient citadel. In Mycenaean times it was a stronghold alongside nearby Mycenae and Tiryns; in the classical age it rivalled Sparta for mastery of the Peloponnese. Its long history left monuments from Greek, Roman and later centuries among the fields and streets of the town.

After the Fourth Crusade, Argos belonged to a Frankish lordship with the port of Nauplia. Venice acquired the town in 1394, but an Ottoman raid in 1397 carried away part of its population. The Venetians encouraged Albanian settlers to cultivate the land, granting them tax exemptions, and men from the district served as mounted stratioti in Venetian armies. The Ottomans captured Argos in 1463. Under their rule the town grew in quarters whose winding streets and gardens gave it a different shape from the ancient city beneath the citadel.
simp_chinese:
阿尔戈斯坐落在肥沃的阿尔戈利斯平原上，拉里萨山及其古老卫城俯瞰全城。迈锡尼时代，它与附近的迈锡尼、梯林斯同为重要据点；古典时代，它又与斯巴达争夺伯罗奔尼撒的霸权。希腊、罗马及后世留下的遗迹散布在城镇的田野与街巷之间。

第四次十字军东征后，阿尔戈斯与港口纳夫普利翁同属一个法兰克领地。威尼斯于1394年取得城镇，但1397年的奥斯曼袭击掳走了部分居民。威尼斯给予阿尔巴尼亚移民免税优惠，鼓励他们耕作；当地人也作为轻骑兵在威尼斯军中服役。1463年，奥斯曼人攻占阿尔戈斯。此后城镇逐渐扩展，曲折的街道和庭园构成新的街区，与卫城下的古城面貌迥异。

english:
Arguin is an island off the Saharan coast, surrounded by the shallow waters and sandbanks of the Atlantic. Its position made it a meeting point between maritime visitors and the caravan networks of the desert. Local traders brought gold, gum arabic and enslaved people to the coast, connecting the island with markets far inland.

Portuguese navigators reached Arguin in the 1440s and established a fortified trading post. Its commerce prospered in the fifteenth century, but Portuguese attention later shifted towards the Guinea coast. The Dutch seized the island in 1638, and European powers continued to contest the coast in the following centuries, particularly for access to gum arabic. African merchants and rulers remained indispensable to the trade that reached the island.
simp_chinese:
阿尔金岛位于撒哈拉海岸外，周围是大西洋浅水与沙洲。它成为海上来客与沙漠商队网络相遇之地。当地商人将黄金、阿拉伯胶及被奴役者带到海岸，使岛屿与遥远内陆市场相连。

葡萄牙航海者在十五世纪四十年代抵达阿尔金，建立设防商站。贸易在十五世纪兴盛，但葡萄牙人后来将注意力转向几内亚海岸。荷兰人于1638年占领该岛，此后欧洲势力继续争夺海岸，尤其希望取得阿拉伯胶。非洲商人和统治者始终是通往岛屿贸易不可或缺的参与者。

english: The Argun descends from the Greater Caucasus through a narrow gorge, linking the highlands of Chechnya with the northern foothills. Stone towers, burial grounds and fortified settlements mark the valley's long occupation. At Ushkaloy, two watchtowers were built into a recess of the cliff, using the rock itself as a fourth wall and roof. A paved road once passed nearby, part of a mountain route towards Georgia. The gorge was both a place of settlement and a passage between the northern and southern Caucasus.
simp_chinese: 阿尔贡河从大高加索山脉流下，穿过狭窄峡谷，连接车臣高地与北方山麓。石塔、墓地和设防聚落见证了河谷悠久的居住历史。在乌什卡洛伊，两座瞭望塔嵌入峭壁凹处，以岩石本身作为第四面墙和屋顶。附近曾有一条石铺道路，属于通往格鲁吉亚的山地路线。峡谷既是居民生活之地，也是南北高加索之间的通道。

english: Arguvan lies in the dry uplands north of Malatya, a country of ridges and small valleys where villages are scattered across the hills. It sits between two older centres. At Arapgir to the north-west, the Armenian Arabkir, Senekerim-Hovhannes Artsruni founded a town in 1021 after giving up his kingdom of Vaspurakan for estates in Byzantine Lesser Armenia. At Divriği to the north, once the Paulician stronghold of Tephrike, the Mengujekid rulers raised the Great Mosque and hospital in the thirteenth century under the Seljuk sultans of Rum.
simp_chinese: 阿尔古万位于马拉蒂亚以北干燥的高地，岭脊与小河谷交错，村落散布在山间。它夹在两处更古老的中心之间：西北的阿拉普吉尔（亚美尼亚语称阿拉布基尔），塞内凯里姆-霍瓦尼斯·阿尔茨鲁尼在放弃瓦斯普拉坎王国、换取拜占庭小亚美尼亚的领地后，于1021年建起城镇；北面的迪夫里伊曾是保罗派据点特弗里克，十三世纪在罗姆塞尔柱苏丹治下，门古杰克王朝在此修建了大清真寺和医院。

english:
Argyrókastro, known in Albanian as Gjirokastër, rises on a hillside above the Drino valley. Its name means the Silver Castle, and the fortress on the ridge formed the heart of the town. Houses spread over the slopes around it, their stone walls and roofs giving the settlement its distinctive appearance. The bazaar grew outside the castle's northern gate in the fifteenth century.

The Ottomans took the town in the early fifteenth century, and by 1471 it was an administrative centre of the Ottoman province of Albania. When Evliya Çelebi visited in 1670, he counted houses inside the fortress and in neighbourhoods extending over the surrounding hills. In 1811 the town came under Ali Pasha of Tepelenë. He enlarged the fortress, adding a clock tower and an extension to its defences, before his downfall in 1822.
simp_chinese:
阿尔吉罗卡斯特罗的阿尔巴尼亚语名为吉诺卡斯特，依山而建，俯瞰德里诺河谷。它的名字意为“银堡”，山脊上的城堡是城镇的核心。住宅沿四周山坡铺开，石墙与石屋顶赋予这座城镇鲜明的面貌。十五世纪，集市在城堡北门外发展起来。

奥斯曼人于十五世纪初占领此地，到1471年，它已成为奥斯曼阿尔巴尼亚行省的行政中心。1670年埃夫利亚·切勒比到访时，记下了城堡内和周围山丘各街区的房屋。1811年，城镇落入泰佩莱纳的阿里帕夏之手。他扩建了要塞，增筑钟楼和防御工事，直到1822年失势身亡。

english: Arhymot Lake lies between the lower Yukon and Kuskokwim rivers, in a country of lakes, channels and wetlands. Its outlet joins the waterway known locally as Crooked Creek or the Johnson River, while a portage links the lake country toward the Yukon. The network of waterways and short overland crossings made travel possible between the two great river systems. In this lowland landscape, shallow lakes and streams are interwoven with tundra and provide habitat for fish, waterfowl and other animals.
simp_chinese: 阿希莫特湖位于育空河下游与库斯科奎姆河之间，周围是湖泊、河道和湿地交错的地区。湖泊出口连接当地称为克鲁克德溪或约翰逊河的水道，一条搬运道则使湖区与育空河方向相连。水道网络和短距离陆路使人们能够在两大河系之间旅行。在这片低地上，浅湖与溪流同苔原交织，为鱼类、水鸟及其他动物提供栖息之所。

sources.title: johnson river ii b interim summary report final 9 15 2014.pdf

english:
Ariano rises on the hills of the southern Apennines, overlooking the roads between the regions of Campania and Apulia. Its cathedral and castle stand above quarters that grew along the ridges and slopes. The town's high position offered command of the passes, but its buildings were repeatedly vulnerable to earthquakes.

The cathedral was destroyed in the earthquake of 1456 and rebuilt in the following century. Bishop De Hippolitis began a new façade around 1500, and his successor completed it. The bishops continued work on the church after earlier rebuilding, while its Romanesque façade preserved the form given to it around 1500. Further shocks in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries damaged the building again, requiring repeated repairs to the cathedral and its surrounding town.
simp_chinese:
阿里亚诺坐落在南亚平宁丘陵上，俯瞰坎帕尼亚与阿普利亚之间的道路。大教堂和城堡耸立在沿山脊与坡地发展的街区上方。高地位置有利于控制山口，但建筑屡受地震威胁。

1456年地震摧毁大教堂，随后一个世纪里教堂得以重建。德伊波利蒂斯主教约于1500年开始修建新立面，由继任者完成。主教们继续修建这座教堂，罗马式立面保存了约1500年形成的外观。十七和十八世纪的地震再次损坏建筑，迫使人们反复修复。

english: The Ariari flows through the eastern lowlands beyond the Colombian Andes. It joins the Guayabero to form the Guaviare, a major tributary of the Orinoco. The rivers carry water from the mountains across the plains and forest margins, joining local channels to a far larger drainage system. The Ariari country was also part of the territory of the Guayupe, an Arawak-speaking people encountered by sixteenth-century Spanish expeditions.
simp_chinese: 阿里亚里河流经哥伦比亚安第斯山以东的低地，与瓜亚韦罗河汇合后形成奥里诺科河重要支流瓜维亚雷河。河流将山地来水带过平原与森林边缘，使当地水道接入更广阔的流域。阿里亚里一带也是瓜尤佩人的土地；这一使用阿拉瓦克语的民族曾与十六世纪西班牙远征队相遇。

english:
Aribinda lies on the dry Sahelian plain of northern Burkina Faso, among seasonal grasses, scattered trees and scarce water. Its compact settlement controlled fields and pasture rather than a river crossing or fortified height.

Local traditions connect it to Songhay migrants from Tendirma on the Niger, later joined by Kurumba from Yatenga and Mossi from Boulsa. The Mossi ultimately held the chiefship, while the mixed population was generally called Kurumba. The hill of Wasa remains part of its origin traditions.

Millet and sorghum grew on the surrounding sandy and clay soils, and cattle supplied manure and wealth. From the fourteenth through eighteenth centuries Aribinda remained a small cultivated territory. Homes clustered near wells while herders maintained seasonal camps beyond the fields, keeping the settled area small and dependent on exchange.
simp_chinese:
阿里宾达位于布基纳法索北部干旱的萨赫勒平原，周围是季节草地、疏树和稀少水源。紧凑的聚落控制田地与牧场，而非渡口或设防高地。

当地传统把聚落起源同来自尼日尔河畔滕迪尔马的松海人联系起来，后来又加入来自亚滕加的库鲁姆巴人和来自布尔萨的莫西人。莫西人最终掌握酋长权，混合居民通常统称库鲁姆巴人，瓦萨山则保留在起源叙述中。

小米和高粱种在周围沙土与黏土地上，牛群提供粪肥并构成财富。早期近代的大部分时间里，阿里宾达只有狭小的耕作范围；住宅贴近井泉聚集，牧民在田外维持季节营地，使定居范围保持狭小而依赖交换。

english:
Arica occupies a narrow coastal shelf in the Atacama Desert, where the Lluta and Azapa valleys carry water down to the Pacific. Sea breezes moderate one of the driest climates on Earth, and river oases supply fruit, maize and pasture in an otherwise barren coast. The site offers an unusual anchorage beneath the coastal ridge.

Chinchorro communities made elaborate mummies along this coast thousands of years before the Inca, preserving a maritime society of fishers and gatherers. Later Aymara and Inca routes joined the ocean to the high Andes. Spanish ships entered the bay in the sixteenth century, and the port became a link between southern Peru and the silver mountain of Potosí. The bay also sheltered small fishing boats and coastal shipping that supplied the oasis valleys.

Arica grew as a colonial landing for mercury, wine, flour and imported goods bound for the Andes. Earthquakes and tsunamis repeatedly damaged the town, while its dry hinterland forced dependence on valley oases and imported food. By the eighteenth century it was a fortified but exposed port whose value came from the exchange between mountain mines and the Pacific.
simp_chinese:
阿里卡位于阿塔卡马沙漠狭窄的海岸平台上，柳塔河和阿萨帕河把水带向太平洋。海风缓和了地球上最干燥的气候之一，河谷绿洲在荒凉沿岸提供水果、玉米和牧场。城市背后的海岸山脊间，形成一处少见锚地。

钦乔罗社群在印加以前数千年便沿这段海岸制作精致木乃伊，留下渔民和采集者的海洋社会。后来艾马拉与印加道路把海岸同高安第斯连接起来。十六世纪西班牙船只进入海湾，港口逐渐成为秘鲁南部与波托西银矿之间的节点。海湾也为小型渔船和供给绿洲谷地的沿岸船只提供遮蔽。

阿里卡凭向安第斯运送水银、葡萄酒、面粉和进口货物而成长。地震与海啸反复破坏城镇，干燥腹地又迫使居民依赖河谷绿洲和外来粮食。到十八世纪，它已是设防却暴露的港口，价值来自矿山与太平洋之间的交换。

english:
Arica Bay opens onto the Pacific at the northern approach to the Atacama Desert. That desert forms a narrow coastal strip roughly 1,600 kilometres long, enclosed between the Andes and the Chilean Coast Range. Both mountain systems block moist air, creating a two-sided rain shadow. The cold, north-flowing Humboldt Current and the South Pacific anticyclone strengthen the same effect, leaving some weather stations with no recorded rainfall while maritime winds produce the region’s characteristic fog.

The adjoining coast is dominated by steep cliffs and an elevated desert bench. Fresh water is scarce, so settlement has clustered around rare streams, springs and coastal foods. People lived along this shore by at least 7000 BCE, later including the Chinchorro fishermen and communities of the interior. During Spanish rule, coastal towns grew as outlets for silver mined far inland.

Their routes tied the barren seaboard to the high Andes and made ports such as Arica gateways between ocean shipping and the desert interior. The coast’s northward drainage and intermittent streams channel scarce water into this meeting zone, while the ocean itself remains cold beneath frequent winds.
simp_chinese:
阿里卡湾在阿塔卡马沙漠北缘面向太平洋。阿塔卡马是一条约1,600公里长的狭窄沿海荒漠，夹在安第斯山脉与智利海岸山脉之间。两侧山系共同阻挡湿气，形成双向雨影；寒冷且向北流动的洪堡洋流和南太平洋副热带高压又加强了这一效果，使部分气象站从未记录到降雨。

海风在当地则常造成浓雾。相邻海岸以陡峭海崖和高起的荒漠台地为主。淡水稀少，聚落因而集中于少数河流、泉眼和沿海资源附近。

至少自公元前7000年起，人们便生活在阿塔卡马沿岸，后来包括以捕鱼为生的钦乔罗人和内陆社群。西班牙统治时期，沿海城镇成为遥远内陆白银的外运港口；这些路线把荒凉海岸同高安第斯连接起来，也使阿里卡等港口成为远洋航运和沙漠腹地之间的门户。沿岸向北的排水方向与间歇性溪流把稀少的水资源汇入这一交界地带，而海面在频繁海风下依然寒冷。

english:
The Ariguaní flows through the lowlands south of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, in country associated with the people known in colonial records as Chimila. Their descendants include the Ette Ennaka of the Ariguaní plains. The river and its tributaries cross a landscape of forest and seasonal wetlands before joining the Magdalena drainage, which carries water northwards through the Caribbean lowlands to the sea.

Spanish expansion met repeated Indigenous resistance in the province of Santa Marta. Conflict continued into the eighteenth century, when colonial campaigns sought to subdue the Chimila and reorganise their settlements. Communities withdrew into the forests of the upper Ariguaní, maintaining a presence in the region despite the pressures of warfare and the pressures of colonial settlement.
simp_chinese:
阿里瓜尼河流经圣玛尔塔内华达山脉以南低地，这片地区与殖民文献称为奇米拉的人群有关。阿里瓜尼平原的埃特埃纳卡人是他们的后裔之一。河流及其支流穿越森林和季节湿地，最终接入马格达莱纳水系，河水由此向北穿过加勒比低地流入大海。

西班牙向圣玛尔塔省扩张时反复遭到原住民抵抗。冲突延续到十八世纪，殖民军队试图征服奇米拉人并重组其聚落。社群退入阿里瓜尼河上游森林，尽管面对战争和殖民聚居压力，仍在当地延续生活。

english: Arikun is a name associated with Indigenous communities of the central Taiwanese plains. Their villages formed part of a broad region of lowland settlements between the mountains and the west coast, linked to neighbouring communities by kinship and exchange. Before the nineteenth century some Arikun people joined other plains communities in moving into the Pǔlǐ basin, at the invitation of Indigenous people already living there. They established new settlements in the basin as conditions in their earlier homelands changed.
simp_chinese: 阿立昆是台湾中部平原原住民社群的名称之一。村社分布在西岸与山地之间的低地，与邻近社群通过亲属和交换联系。十九世纪以前，一些阿立昆人同其他平埔社群一道，应埔里当地原住民邀请迁入盆地，建立新聚落。此时他们原居地的社会和土地状况也在发生变化。

english: Arilje stands in western Serbia where the Rzav and Moravica rivers meet. Above the valleys rises the church of Saint Achillius, founded by King Stefan Dragutin on the site of an earlier cathedral of the bishops of Moravica. Its frescoes, completed in 1296, include portraits of Dragutin, his wife Katalina and his brother King Milutin; the founder holds a model of the church in his hands.
simp_chinese: 阿里列位于塞尔维亚西部，坐落在尔扎夫河与莫拉维察河交汇处。俯瞰河谷的圣阿希利耶教堂由国王斯特凡·德拉古廷创建，原址是莫拉维察主教较早的座堂。教堂壁画于1296年完成，画中有德拉古廷、王后卡塔利娜及其弟米卢廷国王的肖像；创建者手捧一座教堂模型。

english: Ariogana is associated with Montserrat, a volcanic island in the northern Lesser Antilles. Its mountains rise steeply above the Caribbean Sea, and its Indigenous name Alliouagana has been rendered as the land of the prickly bush. Columbus named the island Montserrat during his second voyage in 1493. English settlement began in 1632, with Irish migrants among the early colonists and enslaved Africans later forced to work its plantations.
simp_chinese: 阿里奥加纳与小安的列斯群岛北部的火山岛蒙特塞拉特有关。山脉从加勒比海上陡然升起，其原住民名称阿柳阿加纳被译为“多刺灌木之地”。哥伦布1493年第二次航行时以蒙特塞拉特命名此岛。1632年英国人开始定居，早期殖民者中有爱尔兰移民，后来被奴役的非洲人被迫在种植园劳作。

english: Aristé is an archaeological tradition of the northern Amazonian coast, where forest and wetlands meet the Atlantic. Burial pits along the Cunani River contain ceramic vessels, some shaped as human figures. Their painted and modelled details include faces, hairstyles and clothing, preserving a record of the people who made and used them.
simp_chinese: 阿里斯特是亚马孙北部海岸一种考古传统的名称，森林与湿地在此面向大西洋。库纳尼河沿岸的墓坑中有陶器，其中一些被塑成人形。器物上的彩绘和塑饰表现了面容、发式与衣着，留下制作者和使用者的痕迹。

english:
Aritpa, or Arizpe, stands in the upper Sonora River valley amid a landscape of cultivated riverbanks and dry mountain ranges. The valley was inhabited by Ópata peoples before Spanish settlement. Its position on the river made the town an important centre of the northern colonial frontier.

Jesuit missionaries established a mission at Arizpe in the seventeenth century. In 1776 the Spanish crown created the Commandancy General of the Interior Provinces, and Arizpe became its capital under Teodoro de Croix. From this northern seat officials sought to coordinate the defence and administration of a vast frontier. Its importance changed as the commandancy’s headquarters moved, but Arizpe remained a significant town on the Sonora River. It also served as a base for the administration of Sonora and neighbouring provinces.
simp_chinese:
阿里特帕，即阿里斯佩，坐落在索诺拉河上游谷地，河岸耕地与干旱山脉交错。西班牙人定居之前，奥帕塔人已居住于河谷。河边的位置使它成为北方殖民边疆的重要中心。

十七世纪，耶稣会士在阿里斯佩建立传教区。1776年，西班牙王室设立内陆诸省总司令区，阿里斯佩成为特奥多罗·德·克鲁瓦治下的首府。官员从这座北方据点协调广大边疆的防务与行政。随着总司令区驻地迁移，它的重要性发生变化，但仍是索诺拉河畔的重要城镇。 这里也是管理索诺拉和邻近省份的据点。

english: Ariza grew on the slopes beneath a castle guarding the frontier between Aragon and Castile. Its position made it a prize in repeated conflicts between the neighbouring kingdoms. Castilian forces took the fortress during the War of the Two Peters in 1362; Peter IV of Aragon later recovered it and sold it to Guillén de Palafox in 1381. The town and its dependent villages remained a seigneurial estate.
simp_chinese: 阿里萨在城堡下方的山坡上发展起来，城堡守卫着阿拉贡与卡斯蒂利亚的边境。这一位置使它成为两国反复争夺的目标。1362年两佩德罗战争期间，卡斯蒂利亚军队夺取了要塞；阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世后来收复此地，并于1381年将其出售给吉连·德·帕拉福克斯。城镇及其辖下村落此后仍是领主庄园。

english:
Arjeplog stands amid the lakes of Pite Lappmark, a Sámi homeland of forest, water and mountain routes. Its Sámi name was recorded in 1636, and by 1640 the place was a church and market centre. People gathered here from a wide surrounding country, bringing the life of the interior into contact with Swedish officials and traders.

The discovery of silver at Nasafjäll in 1634 brought a new and demanding enterprise to the region. Mining began the following year, and reindeer carried ore to the smelter at Silbojokk. Arjeplog parish was formed in 1640. In 1659 a Norwegian force crossed the border and destroyed the mine and smelter. A second period of mining began in 1770, with a new smelter at what became Adolfström, but long transport routes and difficulties obtaining labour limited its profitability.
simp_chinese:
阿尔耶普卢格坐落在皮特拉普马克的湖泊之间。这片萨米人的家园由森林、水域和通往山地的道路构成。其萨米地名于1636年见于记载，到1640年已成为教堂和集市中心。人们从广阔的周边地区聚集于此，内陆生活由此与瑞典官员和商人的活动相交汇。

1634年，纳萨山发现银矿，为这一地区带来艰巨的新事业。次年开始采矿，矿石由驯鹿运到西尔博约克的冶炼场。阿尔耶普卢格堂区于1640年设立。1659年，一支挪威军队越境摧毁了矿山和冶炼场。1770年开始第二轮开采，新冶炼场建在后来称为阿道夫斯特伦的地方，但漫长的运输路线和劳动力不足限制了收益。

english: The Arka forms in the Yudoma mountains where the Left and Right Arka meet, then flows through the highlands to join the Okhota. The larger river continues toward the Sea of Okhotsk. Mountain ridges and wooded valleys surround the tributary, which bends around high ground before turning southeast. These waterways link the inland slopes with the northern coast of the Pacific sea.
simp_chinese: 阿尔卡河在尤多马山地由左阿尔卡河与右阿尔卡河汇合而成，穿过高地注入鄂霍塔河。大河继续流向鄂霍次克海。山脊与森林河谷环绕这条支流；它绕过高地后转向东南。这些水道将内陆山坡与太平洋北方海岸联系起来。

english:
Arkaba tura lies within the region of South Australia. Aboriginal peoples inhabited and travelled through its varied landscapes long before European colonisation. Water and seasonal resources shaped movement and settlement across the interior.

Far to the west, Koonalda Cave preserves evidence of ancient Aboriginal activity, including stone extraction and rock art. European surveys of the southern coast included the voyages of Matthew Flinders and Nicolas Baudin in 1802. Britain established the province of South Australia in 1836, bringing colonial rule to a land already inhabited by Aboriginal communities.
simp_chinese:
阿卡巴图拉位于南澳大利亚地区。欧洲殖民之前，原住民已长期在这片多样的土地上居住和往来。水源与季节性资源影响内陆地区的迁徙和聚居。

远在西方的库纳尔达洞穴保存了采石和岩画等古代原住民活动证据。1802年，马修·弗林德斯和尼古拉·博丹分别勘察南部海岸。1836年英国建立南澳大利亚殖民地，把殖民统治带入原住民社群早已居住的土地。

english:
Arkadak stands on the Bolshoy Arkadak River at its confluence with the Khopyor, in the steppe country of Saratov Oblast west of the Volga. River meadows, black-earth fields and shallow valleys support grain, livestock and orchards. The Khopyor connected the settlement with the wider Don drainage and routes across the southern Russian plain.

The settlement was founded in 1721 during Russian expansion into the steppe. Farmers and Cossack-era migrants occupied fertile ground along the rivers, while local markets exchanged grain, animals, wool and household goods. Floods and spring mud made roads seasonal, giving river crossings and higher sites special value.

Arkadak grew as a local agricultural center rather than a large fortress. Mills, churches and warehouses served surrounding villages, and the confluence became a natural meeting point for transport and trade. Its identity comes from the open steppe and the two rivers that fixed routes in a landscape without strong natural barriers.
simp_chinese:
阿尔卡达克位于萨拉托夫州伏尔加以西草原，大阿尔卡达克河在此汇入霍皮奥尔河。河畔草甸、黑土田和浅谷支持谷物、牲畜和果园。霍皮奥尔河把聚落同更广阔顿河流域及俄罗斯南部平原道路连接起来。

聚落1721年在俄国向草原扩张期间建立。农民与哥萨克时代移民占据沿河肥沃土地，地方市场交换谷物、牲畜、羊毛和家庭用品。洪水与春季泥泞使道路具有季节性，渡口和较高地点因而格外重要。

阿尔卡达克发展为地方农业中心，而非大型堡垒。磨坊、教堂和仓库服务周围村庄，汇流处成为交通和贸易天然会合点。其身份来自开阔草原及在缺少天然屏障的土地上固定路线的两条河流。

english: Arkat is a range of low mountains in the eastern Kazakh Uplands, near the eastern foothills of the Chinghiz range. Hills and open grassland form a landscape of ridges and intervening basins rather than a continuous mountain wall. The Espe rises in the Arkat mountains, one of the streams that drain this dry interior. The name also belongs to a settlement among these hills.
simp_chinese: 阿尔卡特是哈萨克丘陵东部的一片低山，靠近钦吉斯山脉的东麓。丘陵与开阔草地构成山脊和山间盆地相间的景观，并非一道连续的山墙。埃斯佩河发源于阿尔卡特山，是流经这片干旱内陆的水流之一；山间的一处聚落也使用同一名称。

english: Arkhan stood near the south bank of the Amu Darya at a crossing linking Tokharistan with Khuttal. The medieval town has been identified with Imam Sahib, north of Kunduz. An imposing octagonal fort rose on an earthen rampart above the plain. Its surviving mud-brick walls and circular towers largely belong to the fifteenth through seventeenth centuries, and fragments of glazed tile have been found inside.
simp_chinese: 阿儿罕位于阿姆河南岸附近的渡口，渡口连接吐火罗与忽都罗。学者将这座中世纪城镇认作昆都士以北的伊玛目萨希卜。一座巨大的八角形堡垒坐落在高出平原的土垒上，留存的土坯墙和圆塔大多建于十五至十七世纪，堡内还发现过琉璃瓦碎片。

english:
Arkhangelsk lies on the Northern Dvina near its White Sea delta, where river routes from the northern forest meet Atlantic shipping. The river connects Vologda, the Urals and Siberia with a sea that remains open longer than other northern ports, although winter ice still closes navigation for part of the year.

The Michailo-Arkhangel Monastery stood at Pur-Navolok by 1419, when Norwegian raiders attacked it. Pomor sailors from the White Sea coast traded along the northern rivers and reached the sea islands and Siberia. English ships entered the White Sea in 1553, and the trading route through the Dvina soon brought Dutch and English merchants to Kholmogory.

Ivan IV ordered a fortress and trading town at the monastery in 1584. New Kholmogory quickly became Russia’s principal outlet to western Europe, exporting furs, timber, grain and naval stores in exchange for metals, cloth and weapons. Peter the Great later diverted trade toward the Baltic, but the northern port remained a shipbuilding and Arctic exploration base. Its warehouses held both local forest products and goods carried from Siberia over the river system.
simp_chinese:
阿尔汉格尔斯克位于北德维纳河靠近白海三角洲处，北方森林的河路在这里同大西洋航运相接。河流连接沃洛德、乌拉尔和西伯利亚；港口开放期比多数北方港口更长，冬季仍会封冻一段时间。

米哈伊尔—天使长修道院到1419年已经位于普尔纳沃洛克，当年遭挪威袭击者破坏。白海沿岸的波莫尔水手沿北方河流贸易，并前往海上岛屿和西伯利亚。1553年英国船进入白海，经德维纳河的贸易线路很快把英国和荷兰商人带到霍尔莫戈雷。

1584年，伊凡四世下令在修道院旁修建堡垒和贸易城镇。新霍尔莫戈雷迅速成为俄国通往西欧的主要出口，以毛皮、木材、谷物和船用物资换取金属、布匹与武器。彼得大帝后来把贸易引向波罗的海，北方港口仍是造船和北极探查基地。仓库同时储存本地林产品和经河系从西伯利亚运来的货物。

english: Arkhangelskoye lies in the open river country south of Tula, near the old approaches from the steppe. In the seventeenth century the Efremov district developed around a crossing of the Muravsky and Zelenkovsky routes, and a stockade was built there as part of Moscow’s frontier defences. A village called Arkhangelskoye, also known as Novosilskaya Slobodka, appears in a survey of 1619–1620 in the wider district. Fields and hay meadows later surrounded its wooden church.
simp_chinese: 阿尔汉格尔斯科耶位于图拉以南的开阔河流地带，靠近从草原通来的旧道路。十七世纪，叶夫列莫夫地区围绕穆拉夫与泽连科夫道路的交会处发展，当地修建木栅堡垒，作为莫斯科边防的一部分。1619—1620年的调查在这一地区记载了名为阿尔汉格尔斯科耶、又称诺沃西利斯卡亚斯拉博德卡的村庄。后来，田地和草场环绕着它的木教堂。

english: Arkhangelskoye lies on the Bokhtyuga, a tributary of the Sukhona north of Vologda. The village and a church dedicated to the Archangel Michael are known from the sixteenth century. In the eighteenth century a new stone church was built in the late Baroque style; its lower chapel was completed and consecrated in 1770. The tall church served a parish of villages scattered along the Bokhtyuga's wooded valley.
simp_chinese: 阿尔汉格尔斯卡亚位于沃洛格达以北的博赫秋加河畔，这条河是苏霍纳河的支流。村庄和奉献给大天使米迦勒的教堂自十六世纪见于记载。十八世纪，人们以晚期巴洛克风格修建新的石教堂，下层礼拜堂于1770年建成并祝圣。高耸的教堂服务于博赫秋加河林谷中散布的教区村庄。

english: The Arkhara gathers the Gongor and Khara rivers on the slopes of the Lesser Khingan, then crosses a low country of forest and marsh toward the Amur. Its basin lies between the Bureya and the mountains farther east. Ancient rock drawings along the middle river testify to people who traveled and lived in this valley long before the modern settlement took its name. Tributary streams drain the wooded hills into the broad wetlands beside the great river.
simp_chinese: 阿尔哈喇河由贡戈尔河与哈拉河在小兴安岭山麓汇合而成，穿过林地和沼泽低地，流向黑龙江。流域位于布列亚河与东部山地之间。中游古老的岩画见证了人们在后来同名聚落出现之前，便已在河谷生活和往来。支流将森林山丘的水送入大江附近的广阔湿地。

english:
Arkhyz occupies a high basin in the western Caucasus, where the cold, glacier-fed Bolshoy Zelenchuk and its tributaries drain a ring of ridges and glaciers. The valley floor lies around 1,450 metres above the sea, while surrounding peaks include Pshish and Sofia above 3,600 metres. Forests cover lower slopes, and mountain passes connect the basin with neighboring valleys.

The site is best known for the medieval remains of Nizhny Arkhyz. Three stone churches stand near a settlement tentatively identified with the capital of Christian Alania, called Maʿas or Maghas by al-Masʿudi. The North Church probably served the Alanian diocese from the tenth through thirteenth centuries; its dome rose 21 metres above a western wall twice that length.

Alania controlled routes across the northern Caucasus until Mongol forces under Möngke destroyed its power in the thirteenth century. The churches remained as landmarks for later mountain communities and travelers. During the fifteenth to eighteenth centuries sheep herding, forest work and movement through high passes defined the basin, while the medieval churches preserved the memory of a Christian kingdom in the mountains.
simp_chinese:
阿尔黑兹占据西高加索一处高盆地，大泽连丘克河及支流汇集群山与冰川来水。谷底海拔约一千四百五十米，周围普希什山和索菲亚山等峰顶超过三千六百米。森林覆盖低坡，山口把盆地同邻近谷地连接起来。

这里最著名的是下阿尔黑兹中世纪遗址。三座石教堂围绕一处聚落，学者曾尝试将聚落认定为基督教阿兰王国都城，马苏第称之为“马阿斯”或“马加斯”。北部教堂可能在十至十三世纪服务阿兰主教区，穹顶高二十一米，西墙长度约为其两倍。

阿兰政权控制北高加索的多条路线，直到十三世纪蒙哥麾下的蒙古军队摧毁其势力。教堂后来仍是山地社群和旅行者的地标。近代早期，放羊、林业和高山通道往来构成盆地生活，中世纪教堂则保存着山间基督教王国的记忆。

english: Cape Arkona projects into the Baltic from the northern tip of Rügen, its steep cliffs marking the island's shore for passing mariners. On the headland stood a fortified sanctuary of the Rani, dedicated to the god Svantovit. In 1168 King Valdemar of Denmark and Bishop Absalon captured the stronghold and destroyed the temple, bringing Rügen under Danish overlordship. The exposed cliffs have since steadily yielded ground to the sea.
simp_chinese: 阿科纳角从吕根岛北端伸入波罗的海，陡峭的崖壁为过往水手标示岛岸。岬角上曾有拉尼人的设防圣所，供奉神祇斯万托维特。1168年，丹麦国王瓦尔德马与主教阿布萨隆攻占要塞并摧毁神庙，使吕根岛臣属于丹麦。此后，暴露在海上的崖岸不断被侵蚀。

english:
Arkavaz lies in the mountain country of Ilam province in western Iran, where ridges and narrow valleys separate Kurdish communities. Oak woodland, springs and seasonal pasture support grain, fruit and herds of sheep and goats. Roads follow valleys between upland villages and the plains toward Iraq.

The city is associated with Kurds of the Malekshahi tribe. Clan leaders governed pasture, water and local disputes, while settlements combined fortified houses with irrigated plots. Caravans carried wool, dairy goods, grain and forest products between Ilam, Mehran and the Mesopotamian lowlands. Mountain passes made the area strategic during conflicts between Iranian states and Ottoman Iraq.

Arkavaz served as a district center within this highland network. Markets, religious sites and administrative offices gathered the produce of dispersed villages. Its identity comes from Kurdish tribal geography, oak-covered mountains and routes linking the Iranian plateau with Mesopotamia rather than from a monumental ancient city. Oak forests supplied fuel and building wood.
simp_chinese:
阿尔夸兹位于伊朗西部伊拉姆省山地，山脊和狭谷分隔库尔德社群。橡树林、泉水和季节牧场支持谷物、水果及山羊绵羊。道路沿谷地连接高地村庄和通往伊拉克的平原。

城市同马莱克沙希部落的库尔德人相关。氏族首领管理牧场、水源和地方纠纷，聚落由设防住宅与灌溉田组成。商队把羊毛、乳制品、谷物和林产品运往伊拉姆、梅赫兰及美索不达米亚低地。伊朗诸国与奥斯曼伊拉克冲突时，山口使地区具有战略意义。

阿尔夸兹在这一高地网络中充当县域中心。市场、宗教场所和行政机构汇集分散村庄的物产。其身份来自库尔德部落地理、橡树山地以及连接伊朗高原与美索不达米亚的道路，而非宏大古城。橡树林提供燃料和建材。

english: Arlal lies east of Timbuktu in the Niger bend, where the river crosses the dry lands of the Sahel. Its waters support a narrow belt of cultivation and settlements amid a much more arid landscape. Communities along this stretch of the Niger have relied on farming, fishing and the movement of boats, while pastoralists use the surrounding plains. The river connects the country east of Timbuktu with the towns and markets farther downstream.
simp_chinese: 阿尔拉勒位于廷巴克图以东的尼日尔河大弯，河水穿过萨赫勒干旱地带。河边有狭长的耕地和聚落，与周围更为干燥的景观形成对照。沿河社群依靠耕种、捕鱼与船只往来，牧民则利用周围平原。尼日尔河将廷巴克图以东的地区同下游的城镇和市场连接起来。

english: Arles stands on the Rhône near its great delta, surrounded by the remains of a distinguished Roman and medieval city. Its amphitheatre and theatre recall the ancient town, while Saint-Trophime and its cloister testify to its later religious importance. Houses came to occupy the old amphitheatre, turning the Roman arena into a fortified quarter. Plague repeatedly threatened Arles. During the outbreak of 1721 the authorities drew on measures used in earlier epidemics, including restrictions on movement and the cleaning of infected houses. In 1735 the town council forbade the repair of ruined houses inside the amphitheatre, beginning a gradual change in the use of the ancient monument.
simp_chinese: 阿尔勒坐落在罗讷河畔，靠近广大的河口三角洲，四周留存着辉煌罗马与中世纪城市的遗迹。圆形竞技场和剧场令人想起古城，圣特罗菲姆教堂及其回廊则见证了后来的宗教地位。房屋逐渐占据旧竞技场，将罗马遗迹变为一处设防街区。瘟疫屡次威胁阿尔勒。1721年疫情期间，当局沿用以往的措施，包括限制通行和清洁染疫房屋。1735年，市议会禁止修复竞技场内的废弃房屋，古代纪念建筑的用途由此开始逐渐改变。

english:
Arlon grew from Orolaunum, a Roman settlement in the country of the Treveri. Its position made it a commercial and administrative centre, and defensive walls rose on the Knipchen hill in late antiquity. Count Waleran of Arlon built a castle there in the eleventh century. The town passed to the counts of Luxembourg in the thirteenth century and shared the duchy's later fortunes.

Luxembourg came under Burgundian rule in the fifteenth century. Wars between France and the Habsburg Netherlands brought destruction to Arlon: in 1558 French troops under the Duke of Guise destroyed nearly half the town and its castle. Capuchins later built a convent on the ruins, and French engineers strengthened the defences. Fire struck again in 1785; in 1793 French revolutionary troops defeated the Austrians nearby and occupied the town.
simp_chinese:
阿尔隆起源于特雷维里人地区的罗马聚落奥罗劳努姆。它凭借位置发展为商业和行政中心，古代晚期人们在克尼普兴山上修筑防墙。十一世纪，阿尔隆伯爵瓦勒朗在山上建起城堡。十三世纪，城镇归于卢森堡伯爵，此后与卢森堡公国命运相连。

十五世纪，卢森堡归勃艮第统治。法国与哈布斯堡尼德兰之间的战争给阿尔隆带来破坏：1558年，吉斯公爵率领的法军摧毁了近半城镇及城堡。嘉布遣会修士后来在废墟上建造修道院，法国工程师又加强了城防。1785年大火再次侵袭；1793年，法国革命军在附近击败奥军并占领城市。

english:
Armagh is an ancient ecclesiastical centre on a hill in the heart of Ulster. Tradition associates its church with Saint Patrick, and its archbishops claimed a leading place in the Irish church. The cathedral and the streets around it made the town a focus of religious authority through centuries of conflict and political change.

In the seventeenth century Armagh suffered during the wars that followed the rising of 1641, and its cathedral required rebuilding. In the eighteenth century Archbishop Richard Robinson undertook an ambitious programme to improve the city, commissioning public buildings and laying out new spaces. He also founded an astronomical observatory, bringing scientific work to the cathedral city. Its old ecclesiastical standing and the ambitions of its archbishops together shaped the appearance of Armagh.
simp_chinese:
阿马是阿尔斯特腹地山丘上的古老教会中心。传统将当地教会与圣帕特里克联系起来，阿马大主教也在爱尔兰教会中主张首要地位。座堂及周围街道使城镇在数世纪的冲突与政治变迁中始终是宗教权威的中心。

十七世纪，阿马在1641年起义后的战争中受损，座堂需要重建。十八世纪，理查德·罗宾逊大主教推行雄心勃勃的城市改善计划，委托修建公共建筑并开辟新空间。他还创立天文台，使科学研究进入这座座堂城市。古老的教会地位与大主教的抱负共同塑造了阿马的面貌。

sources.title: St Patrick's Cathedral, Armagh (Church of Ireland)

english:
Armavir stands on the left bank of the Kuban River where the Urup joins it, at a crossing from the Pontic steppe into the northern foothills of the Caucasus. Before the town existed, Abazins and other Circassian communities used the surrounding grassland for pasture and movement. Tatars from the Crimean Khanate later settled in the area, and the Kuban became a contested frontier between steppe powers and highland societies.

By the seventeenth century, Islam had spread among the Adyghe and the Circassian political order was changing. Armenian communities known as Cherkesogai had long lived among them but retained their own church and commercial networks. They feared losing their religious identity and, at the end of 1836, asked the commander of the Russian Kuban Line for protection and land near Russian settlements.

The Kuban itself was the edge of the Russian frontier. Since the 1790s Cossacks had held a chain of forts along the river, the Kuban Line, facing the Circassian lands across it.
simp_chinese:
阿尔马维尔位于库班河左岸、乌鲁普河汇入处，是从黑海草原进入北高加索山麓的通道。城镇出现以前，阿巴扎人和其他切尔克斯社群利用周围草原放牧和迁徙。克里米亚汗国的鞑靼人后来也进入这一带，库班由此成为草原政权与山地社会争夺的边疆。

十七世纪时，伊斯兰教已在阿迪格人之间传播，切尔克斯政治秩序也在变化。被称为“切尔克斯盖”的亚美尼亚人社群长期生活其中，却保留自己的教会与商业网络。他们担心失去宗教身份，于是在1836年末请求俄军库班防线指挥官提供保护，并准其迁居俄罗斯聚落附近。

库班河本身就是俄国边疆的边缘。自1790年代起，哥萨克沿河驻守一串堡垒，即库班防线，隔河面对切尔克斯人的土地。

english: Armizonskoye stands among the lakes of the Tobol–Ishim plain. Russian settlements grew around these waters during the eighteenth century. A parish register of 1781 recorded twenty-four households at Armizonskaya, alongside neighbouring villages including Vyalkovo, Glubokovskaya and Zubarevo.
simp_chinese: 阿尔米宗斯科耶坐落在托博尔河与伊希姆河之间的多湖平原。十八世纪，俄国人的聚落在这些湖泊周围发展起来。1781年的堂区登记簿记载阿尔米宗斯卡亚有二十四户，附近还有维亚尔科沃、格卢博科夫斯卡亚和祖巴列沃等村庄。

english: Arnarfjörður reaches deep into Iceland's Westfjords, its waters branching among steep mountains and valleys. A peninsula called Langanes divides the inner fjord, with Dynjandisvogur and Borgarfjörður to its north. At the head of Dynjandisvogur the broad waterfall Dynjandi descends in a series of cascades toward the sea. The fjord's long inlets and high shores create a sheltered landscape, set apart from the exposed Atlantic coast beyond its mouth.
simp_chinese: 阿尔纳峡湾深深伸入冰岛西峡湾地区，水域在陡峭山谷之间分出支湾。名为兰加内斯的半岛将峡湾内部分开，北面是丁扬迪斯湾和博尔加峡湾。丁扬迪斯湾尽头，宽阔的丁扬迪瀑布层层倾泻，流向大海。狭长水道与高耸海岸形成受庇护的地貌，与湾口之外迎向大西洋的海岸截然不同。

english: Arnay-le-Duc was a Burgundian town whose name recalls its connection to the dukes of Burgundy. During the French Wars of Religion the country around it became a battlefield. In June 1570 the Protestant army under Gaspard de Coligny faced royal forces commanded by Marshal Cossé near Arnay. The Protestants won the engagement, a victory followed in August by the Peace of Saint-Germain, which brought the third war of religion to an end and granted the Reformed churches a measure of toleration.
simp_chinese: 阿尔奈勒迪克是一座勃艮第城镇，其名称让人想起它与勃艮第公爵的联系。法国宗教战争期间，附近乡野成为战场。1570年六月，加斯帕尔·德·科利尼率领的新教军队在阿尔奈附近迎战科塞元帅指挥的王军。新教徒取得胜利，同年八月的《圣日耳曼和约》结束第三次宗教战争，并给予归正宗教会一定程度的宽容。

english: Arnedo lies in the valley of the Cidacos beneath a castle and hills of reddish rock. West of the town, the convent of Nuestra Señora de Vico stands above the river in a landscape long associated with devotion to the Virgin. The Franciscan friar Lope de Salinas founded the convent in the mid-fifteenth century with the support of his relatives, the counts of Haro, who were lords of Arnedo. Their patronage tied the religious house closely to the town's noble rulers.
simp_chinese: 阿内多坐落在西达科斯河谷，城堡与红色岩丘高踞镇上。城西的维科圣母修道院位于河流上方，这片地方长期与圣母敬礼相关。十五世纪中叶，方济各会修士洛佩·德萨利纳斯在亲族阿罗伯爵的支持下创立修道院；伯爵家族也是阿内多的领主。他们的赞助使这一宗教机构与城镇的贵族统治者紧密相连。

english:
Arnhem grew beside the Sint-Jansbeek, where roads from Nijmegen divided towards Utrecht and Zutphen. Its streams supplied the settlement with water, while the Rhine originally flowed farther away. In 1233 Count Otto II of Guelders granted it town rights and fortified it. Arnhem joined the Hanseatic League in 1443, taking its place among the trading towns of northern Europe.

Charles the Bold of Burgundy captured Arnhem in 1473. Charles of Egmond recovered it for Guelders in 1514, but the city passed to Emperor Charles V in 1543. A change in the course of the Rhine around 1530 brought the river to the city itself. During the Dutch Revolt Arnhem joined the Union of Utrecht in 1579; Dutch and English troops took it from the Spanish in 1585. French forces occupied the town from 1672 to 1674, and its old fortifications were largely dismantled in the early nineteenth century.
simp_chinese:
阿纳姆兴起于圣扬斯溪畔，奈梅亨通往乌得勒支和聚特芬的道路在此分岔。溪流为聚落供水，而莱茵河原先流经更远的地方。1233年，海尔德伯爵奥托二世授予它城市权利并修筑防御工事。1443年，阿纳姆加入汉萨同盟，成为北欧贸易城镇的一员。

勃艮第的大胆查理于1473年攻占阿纳姆。埃赫蒙德的查理于1514年为海尔德收复此城，但1543年它又落入皇帝查理五世之手。莱茵河约在1530年改道，从此流经城边。荷兰起义期间，阿纳姆于1579年加入乌得勒支同盟；1585年，荷兰和英格兰军队从西班牙人手中夺取此城。法国军队于1672至1674年占领阿纳姆，旧城防则在十九世纪初大部拆除。

english: Arno is a low coral atoll in the Ratak chain, east of Majuro. Its many islets enclose a large central lagoon and two smaller lagoons to the north and east. In 1788 the British captains Thomas Gilbert and John Marshall sighted Arno after trading with islanders at Mili, continuing north without landing here.
simp_chinese: 阿尔诺是拉塔克群岛的一座低矮珊瑚环礁，位于马朱罗以东。众多小岛围出一片宽阔的中央潟湖，北面和东面另有两片较小的潟湖。1788年，英国船长托马斯·吉尔伯特和约翰·马歇尔在米利与岛民交易后望见阿尔诺，未在此登陆便继续北行。

english: Arno is a low coral atoll in the eastern Marshall Islands, its islets surrounding a lagoon. In 1788 the British ships Scarborough and Charlotte sighted Arno while sailing from Port Jackson toward China. Marshallese communities had long inhabited these islands and navigated between them.
simp_chinese: 阿尔诺是马绍尔群岛东部的一座低矮珊瑚环礁，小岛环绕潟湖。1788年，英国“斯卡伯勒”号和“夏洛特”号从杰克逊港驶往中国时望见阿尔诺。马绍尔社群早已在这些岛屿生活，并在岛屿间航行。

english:
Arnsberg grew beneath a castle above a bend of the Ruhr in the wooded Sauerland. It was the seat of the counts of Arnsberg and had town rights by 1238. The castle dominated the old town and served as the centre of a small county contested by its powerful neighbours.

In 1368 the childless Count Gottfried IV transferred his county to the archbishop of Cologne, helping to consolidate Cologne's Duchy of Westphalia. Arnsberg Castle later served the electors of Cologne as a residence and, during the Soest Feud of 1444–1449, as their military headquarters during the conflict. The castle was destroyed by artillery fire in 1762 during the Seven Years' War; the town remained an important administrative centre after its fortress had fallen into ruin.
simp_chinese:
阿恩斯贝格兴起于一座城堡之下，城堡俯瞰林木覆盖的绍尔兰地区一处鲁尔河弯道。它是阿恩斯贝格伯爵的驻地，至迟于1238年获得城市权利。城堡控制着旧城，也是一个小伯国的中心，周围强大的邻邦屡屡争夺这片土地。

1368年，无嗣的戈特弗里德四世伯爵将伯国转交科隆大主教，帮助后者巩固威斯特伐利亚公国。阿恩斯贝格城堡后来成为科隆选帝侯的居所，并在1444至1449年的索斯特争斗中充当军事总部。七年战争期间，城堡于1762年被炮火摧毁；堡垒化为废墟后，城镇仍是重要的行政中心。

english:
Arnstadt stands on the Gera at the northern edge of the Thuringian Forest. A gift recorded in 704 names it as Arnestati, making it one of the earliest documented places in Thuringia. It passed to Hersfeld Abbey, whose abbot granted town rights in 1266. Trade in wood, grain, wine and woad, together with clothmaking and milling, supported its prosperity. In 1332 the abbey sold its remaining rights over the town to the counts of Schwarzburg.

Arnstadt became a Schwarzburg residence, protected by strong fortifications that resisted attempts by Erfurt to take it in 1342 and 1345. The counts divided their lands in 1496, making Arnstadt the centre of an upper lordship. The town also became closely associated with the Bach family: Johann Sebastian Bach held his first position as organist at the New Church from 1703 to 1707, following several relatives who had served as court, council or church musicians.
simp_chinese:
阿恩施塔特位于图林根森林北缘的格拉河畔。704年的一份赠与文书记载了「阿内施塔蒂」，使它成为图林根最早见诸文献的地点之一。此地后来归赫斯费尔德修道院，院长于1266年授予城市权。木材、谷物、葡萄酒与菘蓝贸易，以及制呢和磨坊业支撑了城市的繁荣。1332年，修道院将其余城市权利出售给施瓦茨堡伯爵。

阿恩施塔特成为施瓦茨堡家族的驻地，坚固城防抵御了埃尔福特于1342年和1345年的夺城企图。1496年伯爵分封领地，阿恩施塔特成为上领地的中心。城市也与巴赫家族关系密切：约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫于1703至1707年在新教堂担任首个管风琴师职务，此前他的数位亲属已在这里担任宫廷、市政或教会音乐家。

english: The Aro River drains part of the Guiana Shield south of the Orinoco. It is formed by the Sucre, Azul and Alachuela rivers and flows north through the country of the Venezuelan interior. Its basin lies among the great tributary systems of the Guiana highlands, where rivers cross ancient rock and descend towards the Orinoco. Forest and savanna border the waterways that connect this inland country with the main river.
simp_chinese: 阿罗河汇集奥里诺科河以南圭亚那地盾的一部分水流，由苏克雷河、阿苏尔河和阿拉丘埃拉河汇合而成，向北流经委内瑞拉内陆。其流域属于圭亚那高地的大河水系：河流穿越古老岩层，下降至奥里诺科河。森林与稀树草原分布在水道两旁，水道则连接内陆与干流。

sources.title: gv t2 c14 p330 401 lres single preview.pdf

english: The Aroás, also called Aroazes in colonial sources, were an Indigenous people of the Piauí interior. A settlement known as Caatinguinha was associated with them and became the colonial town of Valença in 1762. Portuguese authorities gathered Indigenous people into mission villages as cattle estates spread across the region, reshaping communities that had inhabited its river valleys and dry uplands.
simp_chinese: 阿罗阿人也在殖民文献中称为阿罗阿泽斯，是皮奥伊内陆的原住民族。一处称为卡廷吉尼亚的聚落与他们有关，1762年成为殖民城镇瓦伦萨。随着牧场在地区内扩张，葡萄牙当局将原住民集中到传教村，改变了原本居住在河谷与干旱高地的社区。

english:
Aroche occupies a defensible hill above the Sierra de Aroche, with the Chanza and Peramora streams running through a rugged borderland. Below the town lay the Roman city of Arucci Turobriga, founded under Augustus and largely abandoned after the third century. The higher settlement survived and later became the seat of the regional castle.

The Almohads built Aroche’s castle in the twelfth century under Abu Yaqub Yusuf. During the Christian conquest of the thirteenth century, the Hospital of Saint John and Portuguese forces entered the district. Portugal held Aroche by 1251, and Afonso III granted it a municipal charter in 1255. The Treaty of Badajoz in 1267 transferred the town to Castile, but its position on the frontier kept it exposed to repeated conflict.

Aroche was a walled town by the fifteenth century and maintained a Jewish aljama. During the Portuguese Restoration War from 1640 to 1668, its fortifications and roughly three hundred soldiers guarded the route toward Seville. Raids, displacement, and plague reduced the population, especially in 1649. From the mid-eighteenth century, the calmer frontier permitted demographic recovery, expansion of farming, and greater use of pasture on the surrounding hills.
simp_chinese:
阿罗切位于阿罗切山中一处易守的高地，昌萨河与佩拉莫拉河穿过崎岖边境。城镇下方是奥古斯都时期建立的罗马城市阿鲁基图罗布里加，它在三世纪以后基本废弃；高处聚落则延续下来，后来成为地区城堡所在地。

十二世纪，穆瓦希德王朝在阿布·雅各布·优素福治下修建阿罗切城堡。十三世纪基督教势力征服时，圣约翰医院骑士团与葡萄牙军进入本区。葡萄牙至1251年控制阿罗切，阿丰索三世于1255年授予城市特许。1267年《巴达霍斯条约》将城镇划归卡斯蒂利亚，但边境位置使它不断卷入冲突。

十五世纪时，阿罗切已是设防城镇，并保有犹太社群。1640至1668年葡萄牙复国战争期间，城墙和约三百名士兵守护通往塞维利亚的道路。袭击、人口流散和疫病使居民减少，1649年尤其严重。十八世纪中叶以后，边境趋于平静，人口恢复，农业扩大，周围山坡也得到更多放牧利用。

english:
Arochukwu was the home of the Aro and the center of a network that reached across the forests of southeastern Igboland. Its shrine of Ibini Ukpabi drew people seeking judgment in disputes from far beyond the town. Aro merchants established communities along routes to the interior and the coast, while alliances with neighboring warrior groups helped sustain their influence.

Tradition recalls conflict between Igbo settlers and the earlier Ibom kingdom, followed by alliances involving the priest Nnachi and Akpa forces from east of the Cross River. A unified Arochukwu kingdom emerged in the late seventeenth century. During the eighteenth century Aro settlements spread widely through the region, connecting markets and trading partners to their homeland. The networks carried many goods, but also enslaved people destined for coastal ports and the Atlantic trade. The authority of the oracle, commercial relationships and military alliances together made Arochukwu a power far beyond its own villages.
simp_chinese:
阿罗丘库是阿罗人的家园，也是一个遍及伊博地区东南部森林的网络中心。伊比尼·乌克帕比神谕吸引远方的人前来寻求裁决。阿罗商人沿通向内陆和海岸的道路建立社群，与邻近武士集团的联盟则帮助他们维持影响力。

传统讲述了伊博移民与先前伊博姆王国的冲突，随后祭司恩纳奇及来自克罗斯河以东的阿克帕军队参与结盟。十七世纪末，统一的阿罗丘库王国形成。十八世纪，阿罗聚落广泛分布于地区各处，将市场和贸易伙伴与故乡连接起来。这些网络运送多种货物，也贩运被奴役者，将他们送往沿海港口和大西洋贸易。神谕的权威、商业关系与军事联盟共同使阿罗丘库的影响远远超出自己的村落。

english:
Arock is a place in the high desert of Malheur County, southeastern Oregon, beside Jordan Creek as it descends toward the Owyhee River. Low mountains, dry benches and volcanic rocks surround a creek corridor where willow, grass and seasonal water form a narrow green route. The land lies between the Great Basin and the Columbia Plateau, so its plants, animals and human routes share features of both regions.

Northern Paiute bands travelled through this country to fish, hunt deer and geese, gather seeds, nuts and berries, and visit upland camps. Rock art in the Jordan Creek and Owyhee uplands marks places of repeated settlement and movement. The nearby rock that gave Arock its name carries petroglyphs, preserving signs of life in the region long before ranches and roads.

Jordan Creek provided water for people and livestock and led toward larger rivers and winter camps. The semi-arid setting made springs, snow and floodwater decisive: routes shifted when pools dried or winter blocked the passes. Arock therefore represents a small oasis in a broad dry landscape, tied to Indigenous trails and seasonal movement rather than a single monumental settlement.
simp_chinese:
阿罗克位于俄勒冈州东南部马卢尔县的高荒漠，坐落在乔丹溪向奥怀希河下切的河谷旁。低山、干燥台地和火山岩环绕溪流，柳树、草类与季节性水源形成一条狭窄绿色通路。这里位于大盆地和哥伦比亚高原之间，植物、动物与人类道路兼有两侧地域的特征。

北派尤特人的各支社群穿越此地捕鱼，猎取鹿和鹅，采集种子、坚果与浆果，并在高地营地间往来。乔丹溪与奥怀希高地的岩画标记了反复定居和迁徙之处；赋予阿罗克名称的附近岩石刻有岩刻，保存了牧场和道路出现以前的人类活动。

乔丹溪为人畜提供饮水，并通向更大的河流和冬季营地。半干旱环境使泉眼、积雪和洪水成为关键条件：水塘干涸或山口被冬雪封住时，路线随之改变。阿罗克因此是广阔旱地中的小绿洲，属于原住民小径和季节迁徙网络，而非单一的大型聚落。

english: The central Kuril waters lie among a chain of volcanic islands separating the Sea of Okhotsk from the Pacific. Fog can hide the lower shores while mountain summits remain visible above it, and winter brings frequent gales. In spring, drift ice moves along the northwestern side of the islands; some passes through the straits into the Pacific. Dense beds of kelp fringe shallow waters near the islands, marking the approach to land.
simp_chinese: 千岛中部海域散布着火山岛，岛链分隔鄂霍次克海与太平洋。浓雾有时遮住低处海岸，山顶却仍露在雾上；冬季则常有大风。春天，流冰沿岛链西北侧漂移，一部分穿过海峡进入太平洋。岛屿附近的浅水区生长着密集昆布，也为接近陆地的人提供了线索。

english:
Arona stands on the shore of Lake Maggiore, at the southern approach to routes across the Alps. A Benedictine abbey dedicated to Saints Gratianus and Felinus was founded here in the eleventh century. Under the Visconti, Arona became a fortified stronghold with a castle and defended harbour.

The Visconti had granted the territory to the Borromeo, a wealthy banking family. In 1439 Vitaliano Borromeo acquired Arona, bringing it into the possessions of the powerful Borromeo family. Carlo Borromeo was born in the castle on the rock above the town in 1538. He later became Archbishop of Milan and a leading figure of the Catholic Reformation. The castle and harbour reflected the town's place on the lake route between the Lombard plain and the Alpine valleys.
simp_chinese:
阿罗纳坐落在马焦雷湖岸，位于穿越阿尔卑斯山道路的南方入口。十一世纪，一座献给圣格拉齐亚诺和圣费利诺的本笃会修道院在此创立。维斯孔蒂家族统治下，阿罗纳成为设防据点，拥有城堡和防御严密的港口。

维斯孔蒂家族曾将该地区授予富有的银行家族博罗梅奥。1439年，维塔利亚诺·博罗梅奥取得阿罗纳，使它成为强大的博罗梅奥家族领地的一部分。1538年，卡洛·博罗梅奥出生于镇上方岩山的城堡中。他后来成为米兰总主教和天主教改革的重要人物。城堡与港口体现了城镇在连接伦巴第平原和阿尔卑斯河谷的湖上道路中的地位。

english: The Aroostook flows through the forested country of the northeast to join the Saint John River. Its basin is the largest of the Saint John's tributary watersheds, gathering streams from a broad inland region. The river's name comes from the Wolastoqey language and has been translated as “good river for everything”; a form of it was recorded as Arassatuk in 1699.
simp_chinese: 阿鲁斯图克河流经东北部的森林地带，最终汇入圣约翰河。它汇集广大内陆地区的溪流，流域是圣约翰河各支流中最大的。河名源自沃拉斯托奎语，曾被译作“万事皆宜的好河”；1699年的记录中，这个名称写作阿拉萨图克。

english: Arop lies on the Huon Peninsula of northeastern New Guinea, where mountains descend towards the sea. The peninsula faces the islands across the Dampier and Vitiaz straits, waterways linking the Bismarck and Solomon seas. Its coastal communities belonged to a wider world of seafaring and exchange, while forested ridges separated the shores from the interior.
simp_chinese: 阿罗普位于新几内亚东北部的休恩半岛，山地在这里向海下降。半岛隔着连接俾斯麦海与所罗门海的丹皮尔海峡和维提亚兹海峡，与外海岛屿相望。沿岸社群属于更广阔的航海与交换世界，森林山脊则将海岸与内陆分隔。

english: Aropuk Lake lies in the Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta, a broad lowland of lakes, tundra and winding channels near the Bering Sea. Wet ground, sedges and shrubs surround the lake, while the river systems of the delta provide habitat for fish and migrating birds. The lake belongs to a landscape used by Yup’ik communities whose seasonal movements followed fish, waterfowl and other resources. Across the flat delta, waterways link the interior with the coast and provide routes through a country where firm ground is often broken by ponds and marshes.
simp_chinese: 阿罗普克湖位于育空—库斯科奎姆三角洲，这片白令海附近的广阔低地布满湖泊、苔原和蜿蜒水道。湖泊周围是湿地、莎草和灌木，三角洲河系为鱼类和候鸟提供栖息地。这里属于尤皮克社群利用的地景，人们随季节追逐鱼类、水鸟和其他资源。在平坦的三角洲，水道将内陆与海岸相连，为穿越遍布池塘与沼泽的土地提供路线。

english: Aror lies near the confluence of the Panjnad and the Indus, north of Mithankot. The Panjnad gathers the waters of the Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas and Sutlej through a series of junctions before joining the Indus. The combined river continues south through Sindh, carrying the drainage of the Punjab rivers towards the Arabian Sea.
simp_chinese: 阿卢罗位于米坦科特以北，靠近潘杰纳德河与印度河的汇合处。杰赫勒姆、杰纳布、拉维、比亚斯和萨特莱杰五河先后会合，形成潘杰纳德河，再汇入印度河。合流后的河水向南穿过信德，将旁遮普诸河的水流带向阿拉伯海。

english:
Arorae is a narrow coral island near the equator, the southernmost of the Gilbert Islands and about six hundred kilometres south of South Tarawa. Unlike many larger atolls, it has no central lagoon. White coralline land runs roughly nine kilometres long but only about one wide, so settlements, gardens and fishing grounds sit close to the ocean. Soil is thin, and coconut, pandanus and breadfruit are vital supplies of food and material.

The settlements of Tamaroa and Roreti grew along the single road that follows the island. At the northern tip, stones placed around AD 1000–1500 mark directions to Tamana, Nikunau, Beru and Onotoa. These navigation stones preserve knowledge of long-distance canoe voyaging and the relationships between Gilbertese islands. Elders and local rules governed reefs and land, while fishermen took tuna and shark by hand line.

Captain John Patterson sighted the island in 1809 and called it Hope Island. Fishing, canoe travel and narrow tracks continued to define everyday geography. Arorae’s identity rests on a strip of coral land in open ocean and on navigation knowledge that connected it to a much larger Pacific world.
simp_chinese:
阿罗赖是赤道附近的狭长珊瑚岛，属吉尔伯特群岛最南端，南距南塔拉瓦约六百公里。与许多大型环礁不同，它没有中央潟湖。白色珊瑚陆地长约九公里，却只有约一公里宽，聚落、园圃和渔场都紧邻海洋。土壤浅薄，椰树、露兜树和面包果因此是重要食物与材料。

塔马罗阿和罗雷蒂沿岛上唯一道路发展。北端约在公元1000至1500年间放置的石块，标示通往塔马纳、尼库瑙、贝鲁和奥诺托阿的方向。这些航海石保存远距离独木舟航行知识以及吉尔伯特群岛间的联系。长老与地方规则管理礁区和土地，渔民以手线捕捉金枪鱼和鲨鱼。

1809年约翰·帕特森船长望见该岛，命名为希望岛。捕鱼、独木舟与狭窄小径继续塑造日常地理。阿罗赖的身份来自开阔海洋中的一条珊瑚陆地，也来自连接更大太平洋世界的航海知识。

english: Arorae is the southernmost island in the Gilbert chain, a low reef island facing the open ocean. Stones at its northern end point towards Tamana, Nikunau, Beru and Onotoa, preserving directions for canoe voyages between the islands. Arorae was recorded by a passing European vessel in 1809, long after islanders had established their own routes across these waters.
simp_chinese: 阿罗赖是吉尔伯特群岛最南端的低矮礁岛，面向开阔的海洋。岛北端的石块指向塔马纳、尼库瑙、贝鲁和奥诺托阿，保存着岛民乘独木舟远航的方向。1809年，一艘欧洲船只记录了阿罗赖；那时岛民早已在这片海域建立了自己的航路。

english: Arque lies in the mountain valleys southwest of Cochabamba, where streams drain east from the Bolivian altiplano. The valley formed part of the lands of the Sura, whose territory extended from the high plateau into the warmer valleys of Arque and Tapacarí. Under Inca rule communities from the highlands also held lands in distant valleys, creating connections across the varied elevations of the Andes.
simp_chinese: 阿尔克位于科恰班巴西南方的山谷，溪流从玻利维亚高原向东流去。河谷属于素拉人的土地，其领地从高原延伸至阿尔克和塔帕卡里较温暖的谷地。印加统治下，高地社群也在远方河谷拥有土地，使安第斯不同海拔地区相互联系。

english:
Arques lies inland from Dieppe, where a great Norman castle stands on a narrow, elevated chalk spur above converging valleys. The fortress guarded the approaches to the Channel port and the roads through the surrounding country. Its position became crucial in the struggle for the French crown after the death of Henry III.

In September 1589 Henry IV established an entrenched camp near the castle while the Duke of Mayenne advanced from the interior with the army of the Catholic League. Henry's troops repulsed attacks on their position, and English reinforcements arrived at Dieppe. The victory at Arques helped preserve the new king's valuable foothold in Normandy, from which he could continue the fight for a kingdom divided by religious war.
simp_chinese:
阿尔克位于迪耶普内陆，一座巨大的诺曼城堡坐落在交汇河谷上方狭窄的白垩岩山脊上。堡垒守卫通往海峡港口及周围地区的道路。亨利三世去世后争夺法国王位的斗争中，这一位置变得至关重要。

1589年9月，亨利四世在城堡附近设立壕垒营地，梅讷公爵则率天主教同盟军从内陆推进。亨利的部队击退了对阵地的进攻，英格兰援军也抵达迪耶普。阿尔克的胜利帮助新国王保住在诺曼底的立足点，使他能够继续争夺被宗教战争分裂的王国。

english:
Arrah lies in the Gangetic plain of Bihar near the confluence of the Ganges and Son rivers, about thirty-six miles west of Patna. The Son forms the eastern edge of the surrounding country, its broad sandy bed shrinking in the dry season and flooding the plain during the monsoon. Rich alluvium supports rice, pulses and market gardens, while river crossings connect the region with Bhojpur and the roads toward Patna.

Arrah was an important pargana under the Mughals and a local administrative center rather than a major capital. A Jain inscription found nearby records the name Aramnagar, while local tradition connects Arrah with a Sanskrit term for forest. Temples, markets and landed families drew authority from the fertile countryside around them. Floodwaters repeatedly shifted channels and damaged embankments, making local knowledge of the Son essential.

Bricks and sand from the riverbed became building materials for the town and its neighbors. Agriculture, river trade and road traffic joined the scattered settlements of the Bhojpuri-speaking plain. Arrah’s identity therefore grew from the constant negotiation between a powerful seasonal river and the productive land along its banks. Brick kilns and river landings connected farms with Patna.
simp_chinese:
阿拉位于比哈尔恒河平原，靠近恒河与宋河汇合处，在巴特那以西约三十六英里。宋河构成周边地区的东界，宽阔沙床在旱季缩窄，季风时又淹没平原。肥沃冲积土支持稻米、豆类和园圃，渡口把地区同博杰普尔及通往巴特那的道路连接。

莫卧儿时期，阿拉是重要帕尔加纳和地方行政中心，而非大型都城。附近耆那教铭文记录“阿兰纳加尔”，地方传统又将阿拉同意为森林的梵语词联系起来。寺庙、市场和地主家族从周围富庶农村取得权威。洪水不断改变河道、损坏堤岸，使人们必须掌握宋河规律。

河床中的砖和沙成为城镇与邻村建材。农业、河运与道路往来把博杰普里语平原上的分散聚落连在一起。阿拉的身份因此来自强大季节河与沿岸丰产土地之间的长期协调。砖窑和河岸码头把农田同巴特那连接起来。集市继续连接河岸村落。

english: Arraias grew in the gold country of the upper Tocantins region. At the nearby Chapada dos Negros, people fleeing enslavement established a settlement amid the gold workings. In 1740 the governor Luís de Mascarenhas visited the mining camp and took possession of the deposits; the settlement was moved to the site of Arraias. A further discovery at Ouro Podre in 1792 renewed mining nearby.
simp_chinese: 阿拉亚斯兴起于上托坎廷斯地区的金矿地带。附近的黑人高原上，逃离奴役的人们在采金场之间建立了聚落。1740年，总督路易斯·迪马斯卡雷尼亚斯来到矿营，占据矿藏；聚落随后迁至阿拉亚斯所在地。1792年，附近的欧鲁波德里又发现矿藏，采矿活动得到新的推动。

english: Arran rises from the Firth of Clyde between the Scottish mainland and Kintyre. Mountains dominate its northern half, while gentler country lies to the south. Stone circles and burial monuments testify to settlement stretching back thousands of years, and Brodick Castle overlooks the sheltered bay on the island's eastern shore. Once part of the Norse kingdom of the Isles, Arran passed to Scotland with the other western islands under the Treaty of Perth in 1266.
simp_chinese: 阿伦岛耸立在苏格兰本土与金泰尔半岛之间的克莱德湾中。岛屿北部群山连绵，南部地势较为平缓。石圈和墓葬遗迹见证了数千年来的定居史，布罗迪克城堡俯瞰着东岸的避风海湾。阿伦岛曾属于北欧人的群岛王国，1266年《珀斯条约》签订后与其他西部岛屿一同归属苏格兰。

english:
Arras was the capital of Artois, on the Scarpe, where cloth-makers wove the tapestries that the Italians called arazzi and the English simply called arras. With some thirty-five thousand inhabitants it was among the great cloth towns of the north, trading as far as the East. From 1384 it belonged to the Burgundian dukes, and in 1435 the Peace of Arras reconciled Philip the Good with Charles VII, ending the long breach between the houses of Valois and Burgundy.

After the death of Charles the Bold in 1477 Louis XI took the city; it became French on 4 July 1479, its people were driven out, and settlers from other French towns were brought in to replace them. The Treaty of Arras in 1482 made Artois the dowry of Margaret of Austria, and the old inhabitants gradually returned. Artois returned to the Habsburgs in 1493 and later belonged to the Spanish Netherlands. Louis XIII's army, with Richelieu, besieged it from June 1640 until the Spanish garrison surrendered on 9 August. Spain tried to retake it in 1654 but was driven off by Turenne, and the Treaty of the Pyrenees in 1659 confirmed French possession. Vauban built the citadel between 1668 and 1672, and in 1789 the Arras lawyer Maximilien de Robespierre was elected to the Estates General.
simp_chinese:
阿拉斯是阿图瓦的首府，位于斯卡尔普河畔，织工在此织造的挂毯，意大利人称为“阿拉齐”（arazzi），英国人则直接称为“阿拉斯”。它有约三万五千居民，是北方重要的呢绒城市之一，贸易远及东方。1384年起，阿拉斯隶属勃艮第公爵；1435年《阿拉斯和约》使好人腓力与查理七世和解，结束了瓦卢瓦与勃艮第两家的长期决裂。

1477年大胆查理去世后，路易十一夺取该城；1479年7月4日阿拉斯成为法国城市，居民被驱逐，由法国其他城镇的移民取代。1482年《阿拉斯条约》使阿图瓦成为奥地利的玛格丽特的嫁妆，原居民才陆续回来。1493年阿图瓦回到哈布斯堡手中，后来属于西属尼德兰。1640年6月起，路易十三的军队与黎塞留围攻该城，直到西班牙守军于8月9日投降。西班牙1654年试图夺回，被蒂雷纳击退，1659年《比利牛斯条约》确认了法国的占有。沃邦于1668至1672年建造了城堡，1789年，阿拉斯律师马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔当选三级会议代表。

english: Ar Raydah is a village in the Hadramawt valley near al-Masilah, east of the better-known towns of the interior. The valley cuts through the dry plateau of eastern Yemen, and its settlements cluster along watercourses and cultivated land. Buildings of the region traditionally use mud from the wadi, with thick walls suited to the hot climate. Ar Raydah belongs to this string of communities that share the valley with palm groves and fields.
