simp_chinese: 阿雷达是哈德拉毛谷地靠近马西拉的村庄，位于内陆较著名城镇的东面。谷地切穿也门东部干燥的高原，聚落沿水道与耕地分布。当地传统建筑使用干河淤泥，厚墙适应炎热气候。阿雷达是这串与棕榈林和田地共处谷中的村落之一。

english:
Arroio lies within the Jacuí river country of Rio Grande do Sul, southern Brazil. The Jacuí rises in the highlands east of Passo Fundo and runs south and then east for nearly three hundred miles. Its lower course gathers the Taquari, Caí, Sinos and Gravataí rivers before passing Porto Alegre and widening into the Guaíba estuary, then Lagoa dos Patos, a large coastal lagoon connected to the Atlantic.

Boats could ascend the Jacuí as far as Cachoeira do Sul, and the river and lagoon system connected the southern Brazilian interior with the Atlantic coast. Porto Alegre, founded in 1772 on the Guaíba shore, became the port through which the region's goods moved.
simp_chinese:
阿罗约位于巴西南部南里奥格兰德州的雅库伊河地区。雅库伊河发源于帕苏丰杜以东的高地，先向南、再向东流近三百英里。下游汇集塔夸里、卡伊、锡诺斯和格拉瓦塔伊等河，流经阿雷格里港后形成较浅的瓜伊巴河口，继而流入与南大西洋相通的大型帕托斯潟湖。

船只可沿雅库伊河上溯至卡舒埃拉杜苏尔，河流与潟湖系统把巴西南部内陆同大西洋海岸连接起来。1772年在瓜伊巴河岸建立的阿雷格里港，成为该地区货物运出的港口。

english: Known for centuries as Arroyo del Puerco, this town lies west of Cáceres in Extremadura. The sixteenth century left a particularly rich mark on its buildings: the parish church of the Assumption, the Franciscan convent and the palace of the counts of Benavente all belong to that period. The church also houses a celebrated series of paintings by Luis de Morales, whose work gives the town a distinctive place in the art of the Spanish Renaissance.
simp_chinese: 这座城镇位于埃斯特雷马杜拉的卡塞雷斯以西，数百年来被称为阿罗约德尔普埃尔科。十六世纪给镇上的建筑留下了尤其丰富的印记：圣母升天教堂、方济各会修道院和贝纳文特伯爵宫均属这一时期。教堂还收藏了路易斯·德莫拉莱斯的一组著名绘画，使此镇在西班牙文艺复兴艺术中拥有独特地位。

english: Aars stands in Himmerland, the country south of the Limfjord. Its name appears in 1345, when the surrounding Års hundred was also recorded. At the church is a runestone raised by Asser in memory of his lord Valtoke; it was rediscovered in Aars in 1654. The settlement remained a modest rural centre, with a church and parsonage, and by the end of the eighteenth century it also had a post office.
simp_chinese: 奥斯坐落在利姆海峡以南的希默兰。它的名称见于1345年的记载，周围的奥斯百户区也在那时见诸文献。教堂旁有一块符文石，由阿瑟为纪念主人瓦尔托克而立；这块石碑于1654年在奥斯重新被发现。这里长期是一处规模不大的乡村中心，有教堂和牧师住宅，十八世纪末又设有邮局。

english: Arshgul was a medieval port at the mouth of the Tafna River in western Algeria, facing the island of Rachgoun. It occupied the site of Portus Sigensis, the harbor serving ancient Siga. The eleventh-century geographer al-Bakri described a walled town with gates, a mosque and baths, accessible to small vessels. Its position linked the inland country around Tlemcen with the Mediterranean.
simp_chinese: 阿尔什古勒是阿尔及利亚西部塔夫纳河口的一座中世纪港口，与拉什贡岛相望。它坐落在古代锡加港的遗址上。十一世纪地理学家巴克里描述这是一座有城墙、城门、清真寺和浴场的城镇，小船可以驶入港口。这里将特莱姆森周围内陆地区与地中海相连。

english: Arslanbob lies among the mountains overlooking the Fergana Valley, surrounded by extensive walnut and fruit forests. Walnut trees grow on the slopes between the Fergana and Chatkal ranges, beneath higher peaks and alpine pastures. The forest yields nuts and wood as well as shelter for a rich variety of plants and animals. Villages sit among the wooded valleys, where the annual walnut harvest has long been a distinctive feature of local life.
simp_chinese: 狮门位于俯瞰费尔干纳谷地的群山之间，周围是广阔的核桃林和果树林。核桃树生长在费尔干纳山脉与恰特卡尔山脉之间的山坡上，上方是高峰与高山牧场。森林出产坚果和木材，也为多种动植物提供栖息地。村落散布于林木覆盖的河谷，每年的核桃收获长期是当地生活的特色。

english: Arsubaniket was a fortified town on the Arys River, west of Isbijab on the road toward Otrar. Medieval geographers described it as the principal town of Kenjide, surrounded by walls, towers and a moat, with a large congregational mosque. Pastures lay between the river towns and the steppe. The missionary Abu al-Hasan al-Usbanikati came from the town and travelled among Turkic peoples in the tenth century. Its position placed it on the caravan route from Isbijab toward the lower Syr Darya.
simp_chinese: 阿尔苏巴尼凯特是阿雷斯河上的设防城镇，位于伊斯比贾卜以西、通往讹答剌的道路上。中世纪地理学家称它为肯吉德的主要城市，城墙、塔楼和壕沟环绕城镇，城内有大型聚礼清真寺。河畔城镇与草原之间分布着牧场。传教士阿布·哈桑·乌斯巴尼卡提出身于此，十世纪曾前往突厥人中间。城市处在伊斯比贾卜通向锡尔河下游的商道上。

sources.title: Байпаков К.М. Казахстанский отрезок Великого шелкового пути в серийной номинации ЮНЕСКО.pdf

english: Arsuk lies near the mouth of a fjord on Greenland's southwestern coast, north of Cape Desolation. The mountain Kuunnaat rises above the shore, while the fjord leads inland between steep heights. Saqqaq people lived in this region long before Norse settlers arrived; later Thule Inuit also made their homes here. The settlement of Arsuk was established in 1805, and a timber Lutheran church followed in 1830, adding a new chapter to the long history of the fjord.
simp_chinese: 阿苏克位于格陵兰西南岸一处峡湾口附近，在荒凉角以北。库纳特山高出海岸，峡湾则深入陡峭山岭之间。北欧定居者到来很久以前，萨卡克文化人群已生活在这一地区；后来图勒因纽特人也在此定居。阿苏克聚落于1805年建立，1830年又修建了木造路德宗教堂，为峡湾漫长历史增添了新篇章。

english: Arsuz lies on the coast south of Iskenderun, between the Mediterranean and the Amanus Mountains. It is usually identified with ancient Rhosus, a coastal settlement known by several names over the centuries. Narrow valleys and small plains open towards the sea along this stretch of shore. The town passed through Byzantine, Seljuk, crusader and Mamluk hands before coming under Ottoman rule in the early sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 阿尔苏兹位于伊斯肯德伦以南的海岸，介于地中海与阿马努斯山脉之间，通常被认为是古代的罗索斯。数百年来，这处海滨聚落有过不同名称。狭窄河谷和小片平原沿着海岸向大海敞开。城镇先后经历拜占庭、塞尔柱、十字军和马穆鲁克统治，十六世纪初归入奥斯曼帝国。

english:
Arta stands on the Arachthos River in Epirus, on the site of ancient Ambracia. The Corinthian colony became the capital of King Pyrrhus, who adorned it with palaces, temples and theatres. In the Middle Ages Arta was again a princely capital, its castle and Byzantine churches testifying to the wealth of the rulers of Epirus. Among them is the richly decorated church of the Panagia Paregoretissa, built around 1290.

Arta belonged to a succession of Greek, Italian, Serbian and Albanian rulers in the fourteenth century. It became the centre of an Albanian lordship under Pjetër Losha and Gjin Bua Shpata, before Carlo Tocco captured it in 1416 after a long siege. The Ottomans took the city in 1449 and called it Narda. Its merchants maintained links with Venice and Ragusa, exporting goods from the fertile country around the river.
simp_chinese:
阿尔塔位于伊庇鲁斯的阿拉赫索斯河畔，建在古代安布拉基亚旧址上。这座科林斯殖民城曾是皮洛士国王的都城，他在此修建宫殿、神庙和剧场。中世纪，阿尔塔再度成为君主的都城，城堡和拜占庭教堂见证了伊庇鲁斯统治者的财富。其中装饰华丽的慰藉圣母教堂建于约1290年。

十四世纪，阿尔塔先后由希腊、意大利、塞尔维亚和阿尔巴尼亚统治者掌控。佩特尔·洛沙与金·布阿·斯帕塔以此为阿尔巴尼亚领国的中心；1416年，卡洛·托科经过长期围攻夺取城市。1449年奥斯曼人占领阿尔塔，称它为纳尔达。当地商人与威尼斯和拉古萨保持联系，输出河畔肥沃乡野的物产。

english: Artah guarded the approaches east of Antioch, on roads between the Orontes valley and Aleppo. Its walls and towered fortress earned it the description of Antioch's shield during the Crusades. In 1105 the regent Tancred led Frankish forces against the army of Ridwan of Aleppo near Artah and won a victory that secured the principality's eastern approaches. The stronghold remained a point of contention between the rulers of Antioch and their neighbours.
simp_chinese: 阿尔塔守护安条克以东的通道，坐落在奥龙特河谷通往阿勒颇的道路上。十字军时期，它的城墙和带塔楼的堡垒使其被称为“安条克的盾牌”。1105年，摄政坦克雷德在阿尔塔附近率法兰克军队击败阿勒颇埃米尔里德万的军队，稳固了公国东面的门户。这处要塞长期是安条克统治者与邻邦争夺的地点。

english:
Art'an uji, called Ardanuç in Turkish, is a mountain town in the Çoruh valley of northeastern Anatolia. Its name combines Laz and Armenian elements, reflecting a borderland of Georgian, Armenian, Laz and Turkish communities. The town stands where three streams meet below Yalnızçam Mountain, with the broader district rising toward high pastures and the Çadır range.

The castle was built in the fifth century under the Georgian king Vakhtang Gorgasali and later withstood an Umayyad siege in 744. Ashot I Bagrationi restored the fortress and made the town a centre of the Georgian kingdom of Tao-Klarjeti. Its position on a rocky spur above the valley made it difficult to approach, and the fortress controlled roads between the Black Sea, Armenia and the Anatolian plateau.

During the medieval and later period, Georgian princes, Anatolian beyliks and Mongol armies contested the region. Süleyman the Magnificent brought Art'an uji under Ottoman rule in 1551 after another siege. The surrounding villages combined grain farming, orchards and highland pastoralism, while the town served as a market and administrative centre. Mountain routes and the Bagratid castle gave the small settlement strategic value far beyond its size.
simp_chinese:
阿尔特安乌伊在土耳其语中称阿尔达努奇，是东北安纳托利亚乔鲁赫河谷的山地城镇。名称融合拉兹语和亚美尼亚语成分，反映格鲁吉亚、亚美尼亚、拉兹和突厥社群交汇。城镇位于三条溪流汇合处、亚勒尼扎姆山下方，县域向高地和恰德尔山脉延伸。

五世纪格鲁吉亚国王瓦赫坦格·戈尔加萨利修建城堡，要塞在744年抵御倭马亚围攻。阿绍特一世·巴格拉季昂尼修复堡垒，使城镇成为陶—克拉尔杰季格鲁吉亚王国的中心。岩嘴居高临下，控制黑海、亚美尼亚和安纳托利亚高原之间的道路。

中世纪至近代早期，格鲁吉亚诸侯、安纳托利亚诸贝伊和蒙古军队反复争夺当地。苏莱曼大帝于1551年再次围攻后把阿尔特安乌伊纳入奥斯曼帝国。周围村庄经营谷物、果园和高地牧业，城镇承担市场与行政功能。山地路线与巴格拉季昂堡垒使小聚落具有远超规模的重要性。

english: Artashavan lies in the uplands of Aragatsotn, near the gorge of the Arjut. Its church of Saint Thaddeus was built in the thirteenth century as a three-aisled basilica of black and red tuff. Rebuilt in the late Middle Ages, it endured the violent earthquake of 1679, which damaged its walls and roof. Another earthquake in 1827 brought the building down, leaving fragments of its masonry beside the gorge.
simp_chinese: 阿尔塔沙万位于阿拉加措特恩高地，靠近阿尔朱特河峡谷。村中的圣达陡教堂建于十三世纪，以黑色和红色凝灰岩砌成，是一座三廊式巴西利卡。教堂在中世纪晚期重建，1679年强烈地震损坏了墙壁和屋顶；1827年的又一次地震使其坍塌，峡谷旁只留下残存的石墙。

english: Arthabaska lies in the wooded interior south of the Saint Lawrence, in country associated with Abenaki peoples. The name is of Indigenous origin and has been interpreted as referring to reeds or rushes. In 1802 the colonial authorities proclaimed the township of Arthabaska in Lower Canada. The merchant John Gregory acquired the township with the intention of developing it, but settlement proceeded slowly where communications were difficult; more sustained colonial settlement began in the 1830s. The later town of Arthabaska grew within this township, and should not be projected back as an established town throughout the earlier period. Its history joins an Indigenous landscape to the gradual extension of colonial land surveying and settlement.
simp_chinese: 阿萨巴斯卡位于圣劳伦斯河以南的林地内陆，与阿贝纳基人活动的地区相关。这个名称源于原住民语言，有解释认为它指生长芦苇或灯心草的地方。1802年，下加拿大殖民当局设立阿萨巴斯卡镇区。商人约翰·格雷戈里取得镇区并打算开发，但交通困难使殖民定居初期进展缓慢；较持续的定居直到十九世纪三十年代才开始。后来的阿萨巴斯卡镇在这一镇区内发展，不能将它当作早期始终存在的城镇。地方历史因此连接原住民生活的土地，以及殖民土地测量与定居的逐渐扩展。

english:
Arti lies where the Artya River joins the Ufa, in the forested western foothills of the central Urals. Rivers supplied water, fish and winter routes, while surrounding woodland supported hunting and small-scale farming. Iron ore and fuel made the valley suitable for metalworking before large industry arrived.

Merchant Lugin founded the settlement in 1783 by building a mechanical plant. The works produced scythes and other iron goods, giving Arti a specialized role in the rural economy of the Urals. Skilled forgers, charcoal burners and transport workers settled around the plant, and river roads carried finished metal toward fairs beyond the district.

The settlement grew around one enterprise rather than a fort or princely court. River junction, forest wealth and metal craft together shaped a small Ural place whose products reached markets far beyond its valleys. Metal fairs drew buyers from across the Urals. The valley also supplied charcoal and transport horses.
simp_chinese:
阿尔季位于阿尔佳河汇入乌法河之处，即乌拉尔中部森林覆盖的西部山麓。河流提供饮水、鱼类与冬季道路，周围林地支持狩猎和少量农耕。铁矿与燃料使谷地在大型工业到来前便适合金属加工。

商人卢金1783年建立机械厂，聚落随之形成。工厂生产镰刀等铁器，使阿尔季在乌拉尔乡村经济中拥有专门地位。熟练锻工、烧炭人和运输者聚集工厂周围，河路把成品金属运往县域外市场。

聚落围绕单一企业而非堡垒或王廷发展。河流交汇、森林资源与金属手工业共同塑造了这座小型乌拉尔地点。金属集市吸引乌拉尔各地买家，谷地还供应木炭和运输马匹。

english: Punta de los Artilleros projects into the northern shore of the Río de la Plata, west of Montevideo. The broad estuary carries the waters of the Paraná and Uruguay toward the Atlantic, and its shallows and headlands were important landmarks for sailors. The point appears on an eighteenth-century map of the estuary, when the waterway lay between competing Spanish and Portuguese interests.
simp_chinese: 阿蒂列罗斯角伸入拉普拉塔河北岸，位于蒙得维的亚以西。宽阔河口将巴拉那河和乌拉圭河的水带向大西洋，浅滩与海角是航海者的重要地标。十八世纪的河口地图已标出此角，当时西班牙和葡萄牙势力在这一水道周围竞争。

english: East of Great Slave Lake, the Lockhart River passes through Artillery Lake on its course across the rocky Shield. The Łutsël K'é Dene call it Ɂedacho Tué, the lake of the big caribou crossing. Its shores and narrows are part of their ancestral country, where caribou have crossed the water during their migrations. In the 1830s George Back gave the lake its English name in honour of the Royal Artillery, to which some members of his party belonged.
simp_chinese: 大奴湖以东，洛克哈特河穿过多岩石的地盾，在途中流经阿蒂勒里湖。卢策尔克德内人称它为埃达乔图埃，即“大驯鹿渡水之湖”。湖岸和狭窄水道属于他们的祖先之地，驯鹿迁徙时曾在此渡水。1830年代，乔治·巴克以队伍中部分成员所属的皇家炮兵为湖泊取了英文名称。

english: Artush lies northeast of Kashgar, where the foothills of the Tian Shan meet the oasis country of the western Tarim Basin. In the tenth century it was described as a populous settlement of the Yaghma Turks. Nearby stands the shrine of Satuq Bughra Khan, the Karakhanid ruler remembered for embracing Islam and helping establish it among the Turkic peoples of the region. His tomb became a place of pilgrimage, linking the oasis to the sacred history of Kashgar.
simp_chinese: 阿图什位于喀什噶尔东北，天山山麓与塔里木盆地西部绿洲在此相接。十世纪的记载将它描述为人口众多的样磨突厥人聚落。附近是萨图克·博格拉汗的陵墓；这位喀喇汗王朝统治者因皈依伊斯兰教并推动其在当地突厥人中传播而为人铭记。他的陵墓成为朝圣之地，将绿洲与喀什的宗教历史联系起来。

english: The Artyk rises on the western slopes of the Ulakhan-Chistay range, high in the mountains of northeastern Yakutia. It flows into the Nera from the right, adding its waters to the upper Indigirka basin. Mountain ridges enclose the valley, while the severe climate and long winters mark this inland region. The Nera carries the river's waters onward to the Indigirka and eventually the Arctic Ocean.
simp_chinese: 阿尔特克河发源于乌拉汉奇斯泰山脉西坡，源头高踞雅库特东北部的群山之间。它从右岸汇入涅拉河，属于因迪吉尔卡河上游流域。山脊环绕河谷，严酷气候与漫长冬季是这片内陆地区的特色。河水经涅拉河流向因迪吉尔卡河，最终抵达北冰洋。

english: Artyk-Ata, also called Artyk-Tobe, is a medieval fortified town on the left bank of the Syr Darya, in the Akkol locality near Otrar. Its quadrangular mound covers about 3.7 hectares and has three parts: a citadel and an inner town rising some nine metres in the south-east, and an outer settlement a few metres high in the north-west. Pottery from the upper layer dates from the age of Timur, so the town was still lived in during the fourteenth century. It is often identified with the old town of Arkuk.
simp_chinese: 阿尔特克-阿塔又称阿尔特克托别，是锡尔河左岸、讹答剌附近阿科尔一带的一座中世纪设防城镇。四边形的土丘面积约3.7公顷，分三部分：东南部的城堡和内城高约九米，西北部的外城高数米。上层出土的陶器属于帖木儿时代，说明十四世纪这里仍有人居住。人们常把它认作古代的阿尔库克城。

english: The Aru Islands lie in the Arafura Sea south of New Guinea, their low, forested islands separated by narrow waterways. Traders from Banda and Makassar came to these shores seeking pearls, tortoiseshell, sea cucumbers and other valued goods. In the seventeenth century the Dutch East India Company sought to confine Aru's trade to Banda and Ambon, though the islanders' connections reached beyond the Company's control.
simp_chinese: 阿鲁群岛位于新几内亚以南的阿拉弗拉海，低平而森林茂密的岛屿之间由狭窄水道分隔。来自班达和望加锡的商人到这些海岸寻找珍珠、玳瑁、海参等珍贵货物。十七世纪，荷兰东印度公司试图将阿鲁的贸易限制在班达和安汶，但岛民的联系并不止于公司所能控制的范围。

english: Aru Bay opens onto the Strait of Malacca on the eastern coast of Sumatra. The bay and the coast between Tamiang and Deli were associated with Aru, a polity known to foreign merchants and chroniclers. Ships travelling through the strait passed this shore, where the mountains of the Bukit Barisan can be seen from the sea. In the sixteenth century Aru faced the expanding power of Aceh.
simp_chinese: 阿鲁湾位于苏门答腊东岸，面向马六甲海峡。海湾及塔米昂与德利之间的沿海地区与阿鲁政权有关，外国商人和记述者都曾提及它。船只经过这一海岸时，可以从海上望见巴里桑山脉。十六世纪，阿鲁面对着不断扩张的亚齐势力。

sources.title: the establisment of islamic rule in eastern coast of sumatra.pdf

english: Arua lies beside the middle Solimões, among lakes and forest near the mouth of the Coari. Indigenous communities inhabited this stretch of the great river long before Portuguese occupation. In the late seventeenth century the Jesuit Samuel Fritz extended his missions down the Solimões; by 1749 the Carmelites were responsible for Santa Ana do Coari, one of several missions along the river.
simp_chinese: 阿鲁阿位于索利蒙斯河中游，坐落在夸里河口附近的湖泊与森林之间。葡萄牙人占领之前很久，原住民社群便生活在这段大河沿岸。十七世纪末，耶稣会士萨穆埃尔·弗里茨沿索利蒙斯河向下游扩展传教活动；到1749年，河边的圣安娜-杜夸里传教站已由加尔默罗会管理。

english: The Aruã lived among the islands and channels of the Amazon estuary, including the country around Marajó. Portuguese records from the seventeenth century place them among the peoples called Nheengaíba, speakers of languages unfamiliar to the colonisers. Their settlements and canoe routes crossed a shifting landscape of tidal waters, flooded forests and islands at the meeting of the river and the Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 阿鲁阿人居住在亚马孙河口的岛屿与水道之间，包括马拉若周围地区。十七世纪葡萄牙文献将他们列入被称作宁加伊巴的各族；这些人的语言为殖民者所不熟悉。聚落和独木舟航道穿越潮水、淹水森林与岛屿构成的多变景观，位于大河与大西洋的交汇处。

english: Aruamu is a Papuan language of the lower Ramu region in northern New Guinea. The river and its tributaries wind through forested lowlands and wetlands before reaching the Bismarck Sea. Several related languages are spoken along the Ramu and neighbouring waterways, forming a diverse network of communities between the interior and the coast.
simp_chinese: 阿鲁阿穆语是新几内亚北部拉穆河下游地区的一种巴布亚语言。河流及支流蜿蜒穿过森林低地与湿地，最终流入俾斯麦海。拉穆河和邻近水道沿线分布着数种相关语言，在内陆与海岸之间形成多样的社群网络。

english: Aruba lies off the northern coast of South America, within sight of the Paraguaná peninsula in clear weather. Caquetío people lived on the island when the Spanish arrived; earlier inhabitants had crossed the sea from the mainland by canoe. The Dutch West India Company took Aruba in 1636, two years after Curaçao, using the islands to protect access to mainland salt and support their Caribbean presence.
simp_chinese: 阿鲁巴位于南美洲北岸外，天气晴朗时可以望见帕拉瓜纳半岛。西班牙人到来时，卡克蒂奥人已在岛上生活；更早的居民曾乘独木舟从大陆渡海而来。荷兰西印度公司于1636年占领阿鲁巴，比占领库拉索晚两年，利用群岛保护大陆盐源并支撑其在加勒比海的势力。

sources.title: UNESCO Aruba Heritage report Luc Alofs okt08 0.pdf

english:
Arubeira is associated with Aruba, a dry island off the northern coast of South America. Its rocky shores and sparse vegetation contrast with the wetter islands farther east. Caquetío communities from the mainland lived on Aruba before the arrival of Europeans, leaving pottery, rock images and traces of villages.

The Spanish claimed the island at the end of the fifteenth century and carried Indigenous people to Hispaniola as forced laborers. In 1636 the Dutch West India Company took Aruba after securing nearby island of Curaçao. The island’s position near the mainland and Caribbean sea routes gave it considerable strategic value in the long struggle between the Dutch and Spain, while its inhabitants continued to draw on local island land and marine resources.
simp_chinese:
阿鲁贝拉与南美洲北岸外的干燥岛屿阿鲁巴有关。岩石海岸与稀疏植被同更东面的湿润岛屿形成对比。欧洲人抵达之前，来自大陆的卡克蒂奥社群已居住于此，留下陶器、岩画与村落遗迹。

十五世纪末西班牙人宣称占有该岛，并将原住民带往伊斯帕尼奥拉从事强迫劳动。1636年，荷兰西印度公司占领了阿鲁巴，此前已夺取附近的库拉索。岛屿靠近大陆与加勒比航线的位置，使它在荷兰与西班牙的斗争中具有战略价值；居民也继续利用当地土地与海洋资源。

sources.title: H2 LandscapeSeries The History Of Resource Exploitation In Aruba 10-10-2016-1.pdf

english: The Aruek forest lies near New Guinea's northern coast, east of Aitape and north of the Torricelli Mountains. Mount Sulen rises in that range, which separates the Pacific-facing coast from the Sepik basin to the south. Dozens of distinct Torricelli languages are spoken in the mountains, whose western neighbour is the Bewani range.
simp_chinese: 阿鲁克森林位于新几内亚北岸附近，在艾塔佩以东、托里切利山脉以北。苏伦山耸立于山脉之中，将面向太平洋的海岸与南方塞皮克河流域分开。山区通行着数十种不同的托里切利语言，山脉西侧则是贝瓦尼山脉。

english:
Arujá lies in the Alto Tietê country northeast of São Paulo, at the edge of the Serra do Mar watershed. Small streams, wooded hills and marshy valley bottoms surround the town. Its name comes from the Arujá stream, a Tupi expression commonly interpreted as “abundance of arus.”

The region was crossed by Indigenous Tupi and Guarani peoples and later by Paulista expeditions following the Paraíba do Sul valley. Colonial roads connected São Paulo with the interior and with routes toward Rio de Janeiro. Farms and ranches occupied the better-drained ground, while wetland and forest supplied game, fish and timber. Settlement remained dispersed around chapels, crossroads and mills rather than forming a large town.

Arujá’s position at the edge of the São Paulo basin made it a passage between the plateau and the valleys below. The Tupi name, small river and forested watershed remained the strongest features of a place that grew slowly from rural parishes and estates.
simp_chinese:
阿鲁雅位于圣保罗东北的蒂耶特河上游地区，处在塞拉杜马尔分水岭边缘。小镇周围分布着小溪、林丘和沼泽谷底。地名来自阿鲁雅溪，吐皮语词常被解作“阿鲁鱼丰盛之地”。

图皮人、瓜拉尼人及后来的圣保罗远征者先后穿越这一地区，路线沿帕拉伊巴杜苏尔河谷展开。殖民道路把圣保罗同内陆及通往里约热内卢的路线连接起来。农庄和牧场占据排水较好土地，湿地与森林则提供猎物、鱼和木材。聚落围绕小教堂、路口与磨坊分散成长，没有形成大型城镇。

阿鲁雅位于圣保罗盆地边缘，是高原同下方谷地之间的通道。居民把自给农业同运输、沿线交换结合起来。吐皮地名、小河与森林覆盖的分水岭，长期构成这片缓慢成长地区的核心特征。

english: The Arun rises on the eastern slopes of the Greater Khingan and winds south-east to the Nen River. Its upper valley passes through the wooded country around Chabaqi. In the early Qing period this district formed part of the hunting grounds of the Solon, administered under the Butha authorities.
simp_chinese: 阿伦河发源于大兴安岭东坡，蜿蜒向东南流入嫩江。上游河谷穿过查巴奇附近的林地。清初，这一带属于索伦部的狩猎地，受布特哈总管管辖。

english: Aruni is associated with the Indigenous inhabitants of Chuquibamba, a highland valley in the Condesuyos country of southern Peru. The settlement lies among the western Andean mountains, above the valleys descending toward the Pacific. In the colonial period Chuquibamba was included among the Indigenous settlements of the Condesuyos district. Its agricultural surroundings formed part of a wider Andean landscape of terraces and communities that linked high country with the lower valleys.
simp_chinese: 阿鲁尼与秘鲁南部孔德苏约斯山区丘基班巴谷地的原住民有关。聚落坐落在安第斯西部山岭之间，俯临下降至太平洋的诸谷。殖民时期，丘基班巴被列为孔德苏约斯辖区的原住民聚落之一。周围农业地带属于更广阔的安第斯梯田和社区景观，将高地与低处谷地连接起来。

english:
Aruppukkottai lies south of Madurai in the Tamil country. It was part of the territory of the Sethupathi rulers of Ramnad, whose authority formed one of the regional powers of southern Tamil Nadu. A palace associated with their later landed estate stood at nearby Palyampatti.

The town is known for cotton weaving and agriculture. Its Meenakshi Chokkanatha Swamy temple is traditionally attributed to the thirteenth-century Pandya ruler Maravarman Sundara Pandyan.
simp_chinese:
阿鲁普科泰位于泰米尔地区马杜赖以南，曾属于拉姆纳德塞图帕蒂统治者的领地。塞图帕蒂是泰米尔南部的地方势力之一，附近帕良帕蒂有一座与其后来的土地领地相关的宫殿。

这座城镇以棉织和农业闻名。当地米纳克希·乔卡纳塔庙的兴建，传统上归于十三世纪的潘地亚统治者马拉瓦尔曼·孙达拉·潘地扬。

english: Arusha lies below Mount Meru, a volcanic height rising above the plains of northern Tanzania. Its fertile slopes support cultivation, while the surrounding grasslands provide pasture for cattle. The Arusha people settled on the southwestern slopes of Meru in the early nineteenth century, bringing together farming and cattle keeping in a landscape shared with neighbouring communities of the mountain and the plains.
simp_chinese: 阿鲁沙位于梅鲁山下，这座火山高耸于坦桑尼亚北部平原之上。肥沃山坡适合耕作，周围草地则为牛群提供牧场。阿鲁沙人于十九世纪初在梅鲁山西南坡定居，将农业和养牛结合起来，与山地和平原上的邻近社群共同生活。

english: The Arut River flows through the forested lowlands of southern Borneo towards the Kumai estuary and the Java Sea. Its banks became the seat of the Kotawaringin court when the ruling house moved from its older centre upstream to Pangkalan Bun in the early nineteenth century. The palace established under Prince Imanuddin stood close to the river, reflecting the importance of waterborne travel in a country of forests and widely separated settlements.
simp_chinese: 阿鲁特河流经婆罗洲南部森林覆盖的低地，向库迈河口及爪哇海流去。十九世纪初，科塔瓦林金王室从上游旧都迁至庞卡兰布恩，阿鲁特河畔随之成为宫廷所在地。伊曼努丁亲王建造的王宫临近河岸，体现了水路交通在森林与分散聚落之间的重要地位。

english: Arutua, or Ngaru-atua, is a coral atoll in the northwestern Tuamotus. Its low islets surround a broad, deep lagoon with a passage to the sea. In 1722 Jacob Roggeveen’s expedition visited the atoll; Frederick Beechey returned in 1826 and called it Cockburn Island. Polynesian communities had navigated among these islands long before their arrival.
simp_chinese: 阿鲁图阿又称恩加鲁阿图阿，是土阿莫土群岛西北部的珊瑚环礁。低矮小岛环绕宽阔深潟湖，一条水道通向外海。1722年，雅各布·罗赫芬探险队到访此地；1826年弗雷德里克·比奇再次抵达，称其为科伯恩岛。此前很久，波利尼西亚社群已在岛屿间航行。

english: Arutua is a low coral atoll in the western Tuamotus, its islets and reef enclosing a broad lagoon. The Dutch navigator Jacob Roggeveen visited in 1722. During a later Pacific voyage, Otto von Kotzebue reached Arutua in 1816 and named it after his ship Rurik.
simp_chinese: 阿鲁图阿是土阿莫土西部的一座低矮珊瑚环礁，小岛与礁体围住宽阔潟湖。荷兰航海家雅各布·罗赫芬于1722年到访。1816年奥托·冯·科策布抵达阿鲁图阿，以所乘“留里克”号为其命名。

english:
Arvidsjaur is a meeting place in the forest Sámi country of Lapland. Families travelled here from their hunting, fishing and reindeer grounds to attend church, trade and meet kin. Around the church grew Lappstaden, a cluster of Sámi timber dwellings and storehouses whose arrangement reflected family ties and the areas from which their owners came.

A chapel existed here in the sixteenth century. In 1606 the crown's representative Daniel Hjort designated Arvidsjaur a market and court site, and a new church was completed in 1607. The crown sought to bring trade and taxation under closer control, while church attendance brought together people whose livelihoods required seasonal movement. By the eighteenth century Forest Sámi families had built their own shelters near the church. Swedish farming settlement spread slowly: in 1695 the local Sámi tax lands had over thirty taxpayers, while a larger increase in new farms came only after 1800. When a new church was built in 1826, Lappstaden moved to a new site beside it.
simp_chinese:
阿尔维斯尧尔是拉普兰森林萨米地区的一处聚会地点。家庭从各自的渔猎地和驯鹿牧地来到这里，参加礼拜、交易并探望亲族。教堂周围逐渐形成拉普斯塔登，萨米人的木屋和贮藏室依照亲属关系及主人所属的地区排列。

十六世纪，这里已有一座礼拜堂。1606年，王室代表丹尼尔·约特将阿尔维斯尧尔指定为集市和法庭所在地，1607年一座新教堂建成。王室借此加强对贸易和税收的控制，教堂活动则将因生计而季节迁徙的人们聚集起来。到十八世纪，森林萨米家庭已在教堂附近建起自己的居所。瑞典农耕定居发展缓慢：1695年，当地萨米纳税土地上有三十多名纳税者，而新农场数量的大幅增长直到1800年后才出现。1826年新教堂建成时，拉普斯塔登迁到其旁的新址。

english:
Aryaru, known in Cham sources as Aia Ru, was a coastal region of Champa around Phú Yên. Its river plains lie between the mountains of the interior and the sea, while Cham religious sites attest to a long history of settlement. The area remained under Cham rule into the seventeenth century, although Vietnamese migrants had already moved south across the frontier.

In 1611 the Nguyễn rulers sent an army south and annexed much of Aia Ru. Cham and Vietnamese accounts present the fighting from different sides, but the result was a lasting shift of the frontier. Vietnamese authority was established in Phú Yên while the Cham polity continued farther south, with its heartland around Panduranga. The older sacred sites remained as evidence of the region's Cham past.
simp_chinese:
阿梨耶鲁在占语资料中称为阿耶鲁，是占婆位于富安一带的沿海地区。河流平原介于内陆山地与海洋之间，占婆宗教遗址见证了这里悠久的定居历史。直到十七世纪，这片地区仍由占人统治，尽管越南移民此前已越过边界南迁。

1611年，阮氏统治者派军南下，吞并了阿耶鲁的大部分地区。占人与越南人的记载对冲突各有不同叙述，但边界由此发生持久变化。阮氏在富安建立统治，而占婆政权继续存在于更南方，以宾童龙一带为中心。当地较早的圣址则保留了这片土地占婆时代的痕迹。

english:
Arykbalyk lies in the lake country of northern Kazakhstan. Water and pasture shaped movement through the surrounding steppe, where communities had long made use of seasonal resources.

A settlement bearing the name Arykbalyk was established as a Cossack stanitsa in 1824, during the expansion of Russian imperial administration into the Kazakh steppe. Local accounts describe several groups of Cossack settlers, including families brought from the Don region.
simp_chinese:
阿雷克巴雷克位于哈萨克斯坦北部的湖泊地带。水源和牧场影响着周围草原上的往来，当地社群长期利用随季节变化的资源。

1824年，一座名为阿雷克巴雷克的哥萨克村镇建立，当时俄罗斯帝国的行政体系正向哈萨克草原扩展。地方记载提到数批哥萨克移民，其中包括从顿河地区迁来的家庭。

english: Arylaax lies near the lower Kele, not far from its meeting with the Aldan. Descending from a lake in the Verkhoyansk Range, the Kele crosses a floodplain dotted with hundreds of lakes before entering the Aldan upstream of the Tumara mouth.
simp_chinese: 阿雷拉赫靠近克列河下游与阿尔丹河的汇合处。克列河发源于上扬斯克山脉中的一个湖泊，穿过点缀着数百座湖泊的泛滥平原，在图马拉河口上游汇入阿尔丹河。

english: Lake Arys occupies a low, enclosed basin on the eastern edge of the Aryskum sands. Its salt water can disappear in the summer, leaving the lake bed exposed. Some fifteen kilometres to the west, an escarpment rises above the lower plain and separates it from a plateau. The surrounding Aryskum lies between the Aral Karakum sands and the Betpak-Dala.
simp_chinese: 阿雷斯湖坐落在阿雷斯库姆沙地东缘一处低洼封闭的湖盆中。咸水在夏季可能消失，露出湖床。向西约十五公里，一道陡崖高出低平原，将它与台地分隔。周围的阿雷斯库姆沙地位于咸海卡拉库姆沙地与别特帕克达拉之间。

english: Arzamas stands on the Tyosha, a tributary of the Oka. Founded in 1578 during the reign of Ivan IV in lands inhabited by Mordvins, it grew into a transit centre on the road from Moscow to eastern Russia. By 1737 the town had more than 7,000 inhabitants and was known for leather crafts, geese and onions. The painter Alexander Stupin opened an art school here in 1802.
simp_chinese: 阿尔扎马斯坐落在奥卡河支流乔沙河畔。1578年，伊凡四世统治时期，城镇建立在莫尔多瓦人居住的土地上，后来发展为莫斯科通往俄罗斯东部道路上的过境中心。到1737年，居民已超过7000人，当地以皮革手艺、鹅和洋葱著称。画家亚历山大·斯图平于1802年在此开办美术学校。

english: Arzew lies on a broad bay east of Oran on the Mediterranean coast of Algeria. The sheltered gulf opens toward the inland plains of the Sig and Habra. Ancient Portus Magnus stood nearby, at a site a few kilometers from the later town, and its harbor connected the surrounding country with maritime routes. The bay has long provided an anchorage along this stretch of the western Algerian coast.
simp_chinese: 阿尔泽位于阿尔及利亚地中海海岸奥兰以东的宽阔海湾。避风海湾通向锡格和哈卜拉内陆平原。古代的大港位于附近，距后来的城镇数公里，其港湾将周边地区与海上航路联系起来。这片海湾长期以来为阿尔及利亚西部海岸提供锚地。

english: Arzgir lies in the dry steppe north of the Kuma, where a shallow ravine crosses the open plain. The land belonged to the country used by the Stavropol Turkmens, pastoral communities whose herds moved through the grasslands between the Kuma and Manych. Wells and seasonal watercourses punctuated the otherwise exposed terrain. The village of Arzgir was established only later, on land formerly used by these communities; the ravine had already given its name to the district.
simp_chinese: 阿尔兹吉尔位于库马河以北干燥的草原，一道浅沟横穿开阔平原。这片土地属于斯塔夫罗波尔土库曼人的活动地区，牧民带着牲畜在库马河与马内奇河之间的草地迁徙。水井和季节性河道点缀着无遮蔽的地形。阿尔兹吉尔村庄直到后来才在这些社区先前使用的土地上建立，沟谷早已赋予这一地区名称。

english: Arzu, or Arzuiyeh, lies in the warm plains south of Baft, between the highlands of Kerman and the lower country towards the Strait of Hormuz. Underground water channels have long supplied settlements in this dry district. The region also has a tradition of woven household goods, from rugs and saddle bags to narrow woven bands, made by rural and pastoral communities of southern Kerman.
simp_chinese: 阿尔祖又称阿尔祖伊耶，位于巴夫特以南的温暖平原，介于克尔曼高地与通向霍尔木兹海峡的低地之间。地下水渠长期为这片干旱地区的聚落供水。当地也有编织家用物品的传统，克尔曼南部的农牧社群制作地毯、鞍袋和狭长织带等用品。

english: Al-Salafiyah lies in the mountains of Raymah, above the western valleys of Yemen. Terraced fields climb its steep slopes, held in place by stone walls that preserve soil and help retain rainwater. In the valley of Wadi Rima, the geographer al-Hamdani described a market called Shajban at the boundary between Jiblan and the districts west of Dhamar. The region's villages and cultivable terraces occupy a landscape of ridges and deep valleys between the highlands and Tihama.
simp_chinese: 萨拉菲亚位于也门西部诸山谷上方的赖马山区。梯田攀上陡坡，石墙固定土壤并帮助留住雨水。在里马干河谷，地理学家哈姆达尼记载过一个名为沙杰班的市场，位于吉卜兰与扎马尔以西诸地区的边界。当地村庄和耕作梯田分布在高地与提哈马之间的山脊深谷中。

english: Al-Salif lies on the Red Sea coast of Yemen, beside a prominent deposit of rock salt in the northern Tihama. Salt rises through the coastal plain here, forming an exposed ridge near the sea. Mines around al-Salif and nearby Jabal al-Milh were known in medieval times, supplying a valuable mineral in a region where the arid plain meets the shipping routes of the Red Sea. The deposits gave the coastal settlement a resource quite distinct from the crops of the Yemeni highlands.
simp_chinese: 萨利夫位于也门红海海岸、提哈马北部一处显著的岩盐矿床旁。盐层从沿海平原隆起，在近海形成出露的山脊。萨利夫和附近米勒山的盐矿在中世纪已有记载，为干旱平原与红海航路交接的地区提供珍贵矿物。盐矿使这座沿海聚落拥有不同于也门高地农作物的资源。

sources.title: 353370078 Salt Routes in South Arabia and around the Red Sea in South Arabian Long-Distance Trade in Antiquity Edited by George Hatke and Ronald Ruzicka Cambridge Scholars Publishing 2021 p 154-173

english: As-Sib lies on the Gulf of Oman west of Muscat, at the eastern end of the Batinah coast. Its shore belongs to a chain of fishing and trading places along the plain between the sea and the mountains. The Portuguese knew the settlement as Sibo and included it among their positions on the Omani coast. Small boats used the harbour to travel to and from Muscat, while the sea supplied fish to communities living along the shore.
simp_chinese: 锡卜位于马斯喀特以西的阿曼湾畔，处在巴提纳海岸东端。海洋与山脉之间的平原上分布着一连串渔业和贸易聚落，锡卜便是其中之一。葡萄牙人称此地为锡博，将其列入阿曼海岸的据点。小船通过港口往返马斯喀特，沿岸居民也从海中获取鱼类。

english: As-Sulaymi lies in a valley south of Hail, enclosed by granite hills to the west and south and volcanic heights to the north. Local accounts trace the settlement to members of the Sulaym branch of Banu Tamim, who dug wells and cultivated a valley once covered with acacia. Farms and orchards grew around the wells, and a fortified enclosure was built near them. The nearby oasis of Qana is also known for its palms and shallow fresh water.
simp_chinese: 苏莱米位于哈伊勒以南的山谷，西、南两面有花岗岩山丘环绕，北面则是火山高地。地方记载称，聚落由巴努泰米姆部族苏莱姆支系的人建立，他们在曾长满金合欢的谷地中凿井耕种。农庄与果园围绕水井发展，附近还筑有设防围墙。邻近的卡纳绿洲也以枣椰树和浅层淡水闻名。

english: As-Suwaydirah lies east of Medina, at a watering place formerly known as al-Taraf. Ancient rock carvings and inscriptions cover the sides of its valley, recording people and animals in a landscape of mountains and dry watercourses. The settlement stood on a branch of the pilgrimage road from Iraq to Medina. Ibn Rustah described al-Taraf as inhabited in the pilgrimage season, with rainwater collected in pools for those who stopped there.
simp_chinese: 苏韦迪拉位于麦地那以东，旧称塔拉夫，是一处水源地。古代岩画和铭文分布在谷地两侧的岩面上，在山地与干河谷之间记录了人和动物。聚落位于伊拉克通往麦地那的朝觐支线上。伊本·鲁斯泰记述塔拉夫在朝觐季节有人居住，停驻者可以使用池中汇集的雨水。

english: As-Suwayriqiyah is a settlement in the uplands southeast of Medina, near the volcanic country of Harrat Rahat. Its name is associated with the nearby valley of Suwariq, whose waters descend from the lava field. Old documents record arrangements for the protection of its inhabitants by tribal leaders, reflecting the importance of local agreements among the communities of this part of the Hejaz.
simp_chinese: 苏韦里基亚是麦地那东南高地的一处聚落，靠近拉哈特火山岩地带。它的名字与附近苏瓦里格谷有关，谷中的水从火山岩地带流下。旧文书记载了部族首领保护当地居民的安排，反映出地方协议对汉志这一地区各社区的重要性。

english: Asa lies on the San'yōdō in western Nagato, where the Asa River waters the surrounding fields. After the Battle of Sekigahara, a branch of the Mōri family established its residence here, and the town prospered as a post station. An irrigation weir and channels transformed the land known as Senjōgahara into rice fields. Local tradition credits the work to Netarō, a legendary sleeper whose story became attached to the waterworks during the Edo period.
simp_chinese: 厚狭位于长门西部的山阳道上，厚狭川灌溉着周围田地。关原之战后，毛利氏一支在此设立居馆，厚狭也作为宿场兴盛起来。堰坝和水渠将名为千町原的土地变成稻田。地方传说将这项工程归功于爱睡觉的寝太郎；江户时代，这个故事与当地水利设施联系在一起。

english:
Asadabad lies west of Hamadan on the old road from Baghdad across the Iranian plateau. A pass through the Alvand mountains separates it from Hamadan, making the town a natural stopping place on a major route through the Zagros. Medieval travellers described gardens and water in the district, while nearby remains known as the Kitchens of Khosrow recalled the region's Sasanian past.

Its road brought armies as well as merchants. In 1029 Oghuz and Daylami raiders plundered the district after the fall of Hamadan. In 1120 the forces of Masud, governor of Mosul, Jazira and Azerbaijan, fought near Asadabad against the army of the Seljuk Sultan Mahmud. The rebels were defeated by the sultan's general Aqsonqor Borsuqī. The town remained a stage on the road linking western Iran with the lands beyond the mountains.
simp_chinese:
阿萨达巴德位于哈马丹以西，坐落在巴格达通往伊朗高原的古道上。阿尔万德山脉的隘口将它与哈马丹分隔，使城镇成为穿越扎格罗斯山脉要道上的天然歇脚地。中世纪旅人记述了当地的花园与水源，附近称作“霍斯劳厨房”的遗迹则令人想起萨珊时代的往事。

商人与军队都经过这条道路。1029年，哈马丹陷落后，乌古斯和戴拉姆劫掠者洗劫了此地。1120年，摩苏尔、贾济拉与阿塞拜疆总督马苏德的军队在阿萨达巴德附近与塞尔柱苏丹马哈茂德的军队交战。苏丹将领阿克孙库尔·布尔苏奇击败了叛军。此地仍是连接伊朗西部与山脉另一侧的道路上的一站。

english: Asadabad stands where the Pech River joins the Kunar, between ridges of the Hindu Kush. The place was formerly known as Chighansarai and lay on routes connecting the mountain valleys with the lands towards Jalalabad and the Indus. Babur mentioned taking the town in his memoirs, describing how local people helped defend it against his forces. To the north and west lay the steep valleys of Kafiristan, whose communities preserved distinctive languages and traditions.
simp_chinese: 阿萨达巴德坐落在佩奇河与库纳尔河汇合处，兴都库什山脊环绕两侧。这里旧称奇甘萨赖，位于连接山谷与贾拉拉巴德、印度河方向的道路上。巴布尔在回忆录中提到攻取此城，也记述当地居民曾协助守城抵抗他的军队。北面和西面是卡菲里斯坦的陡峭山谷，那里各社群保有独特的语言和传统。
